author: kpounds
text: This is easily my favorite ice cream ever. I can most definitely eat a Ben and Jerry's pint in one sitting. It's the perfect amount of sweet and creamy and is the perfect treat for any occasion. It's pricey so I usually only get it once and a while but definitely love this product.

author: memberf0fa3
text: Ive never had such a good chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream. I have love all of the Ben & Jerrys flavors Ive had so far but I never thought I would like cookie dough. But they proved me wrong. It had a perfect amount of cookie dough and tasted AMAZING. I 100% recommended this

author: angelac154
text: I absolutely love Ben & Jerry's ice cream I have a hard time stopping when I'm eating it. I've been eating Ben & Jerry's for years. This is me only brand of chocolate chip cookie dough that has a good flavor that I have found. I buy this as well as a few other flavors regularly.

author: oakleykennedy
title: Usually incredible
text: It's usually so so great and I bought a pint the other day and have just opened it to eat it and the cookie dough is all dry and crumbly i literally had to spit it out it was so bad, am dissappointed because its quite expensive and I only buy it once in a blue moon as a treat

author: alil02ec
text: Its good I just wish it had bigger chunks of cookie dough. Plus it would be sooo much better if we could buy any flavor by the gallon so there werent as many visits to the grocery store to buy more ice cream!!! [product:ben-&-jerrys-ice-cream-chocolate-chip-cookie-dough-16oz]

author: makeupbymeiv
text: This is my FAVORITE ice cream flavor. I've tried other brands but ben and jerry's does it best! There are some brands that have super hard cookie dough pieces, but the ones in this brand are so soft and chewy! It goes super well with the chocolate chips and vanilla ice cream

author: ashleyr8b6e
text: I absolutely love this ice cream! It tastes amazing! Its hard to keep it in my house because my children and I love it so much so I have to buy 2 at a time and hide one! I hide it right under the frozen vegetables and they never know! Lol I definitely recommend trying this!

author: natalien4
text: Ben & Jerry's is a brand that you can NEVER go wrong with to satisfy your ice cream needs. I love Ben & Jerry's, especially any Cookie Dough flavored ice creams. This brand has never failed to make me happy, and invite me to new flavor combinations I couldn't even think of!

author: gwynedolynp
text: Many people do not know this but I live for cookie dough ice cream! Its my favorite flavor! I love Ben & Jerrys because it gives me all of cookie dough pieces it can fit in the cup, lol. Super delicious and I always grab this in the store whenever Im in the ice cream mood!

author: dakotaw3
text: I love me a good cookie dough ice cream! Its so delicious! Also Ben & Jerrys high key supports the #BLM movement. So we STAN Ben & Jerrys in this household. 10/10 recommend to anyone and everyone in literally the entire world. Go get you some Ben & Jerrys. Like. Right now.

author: pandabehr_est
text: One of my favorite cookie dough ice creams! While I dont purchase Ben & Jerrys often, when I do this is typically my go to flavor. You get a good amount of cookie dough especially compared to some other companies that make cookie dough. Plus the flavors all mesh together!

author: fernief
text: The chocolate chip cookie dough is amazing, Ben & jerry's has come a long way in making a premium product and the cost sometimes may be high but the quality is great so paying more for the brand is so worth it! I will buy it again and keep trying all of the crazy flavors

author: andreaviolin
text: My favorite flavor. I like that you actually get cookie dough bits in this. The chocolate chip mixed in with the vanilla ice cream really helps balance out the sweetness of the cookie dough. This is my favorite and I love this flavor of ice cream. I keep re-purchasing it

author: marine_a
text: This is one of my top favorite ice cream brand. I love the different flavors they have and I cant choose a favorite one because I love all of the flavors. For me its not overly sweet. And doesn't leave any weird after taste in my mouth. I would definatley 100% recommend.

author: stilla
text: A classic for all to love. It may be a little more fattening than other flavors but that means you can split up how you eat it a savor the deliciousness of this amazing treat. Highly recommend it to cookie lovers, cookie dough lovers, people with a sweet tooth and more!

author: ecjo13
text: This is my favorite brand to buy cookie dough from. The ice cream itself is so creamy and delicious. The cookie dough pieces are so good! And they give you a good amount of them in the ice cream. It is a little expensive but you get what you pay for and this is quality

author: lexeeb1
text: Always will be in love with cookie dough ice cream and I don’t know if it’s just me or not but some cookie dough or chocolate chips taste differently in other ice cream brands. Ben & Jerry’s definitely doesn’t disappoint when it comes to their ice cream. I’m obsessed!

author: ajroxurvanitym
text: I'm a huge fan of chocolate chip cookie dough. Oddly enough out of the three I've tried I really only like this one from ben and Jerry's. I have to eat it over time though because it's so sweet. I like how it still tastes like cookie dough though and not just chunks.

author: missymissjamie
text: Best Ice Cream ! The vanilla taste so rich and creamy! I buy about 3 pints every single week because it's so good ! I would add more cookie dough to the ice cream it def taste better than any other brand it taste more natural ! I would buy this product all the time !

Ben and Jerry's has to be the best ice cream that there is on the market. The different types of ice cream they come up with is pure genius. It is so hard to pick on flavor to be your favorite. They come in perfect little containers so they make a great little snack.

author: allyhawk13
text: I love cookie dough, so I loved [product:ben-&-jerrys-ice-cream-chocolate-chip-cookie-dough-16oz]. This is perfect for people who love chocolate chip cookies. It was affordable and i wouldnt change anything about it. Very delicious and definitely would buy it again.

author: carolmpileggi
text: My absolute favorite! Loooove the big chunks of dough all throughout the ice cream. I can eat the whole pint in one sitting if Im not paying attention... if I have to find a fault is the size, I would like more variation as for a bigger family you will need multiple

author: brittanys36e9

author: kristinka_v_s
text: Simply delicious! Not too much chocolate, not too much vanilla, amazing balance of traditional Ben&Jerry's ice cream with cookie dough! A bit too sweet but at the same time the ice cream can never have too much sugar. I always have a tub of this flavor iny freezer.

author: angiel68
text: This was delicious. They have chunks of cookie dough so thats theres at least one little cookie dough bite in each spoon full. Theres also a great balance of the cookie dough, chocolate chips, and ice cream so that youre able to actually taste all the ingredients.

author: makaylab19
text: Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream has been a favorite of mine since I can remember. I always appreciate the rich vanilla ice cream and chunks of cookie dough. I always end up finishing it in one sitting. Classic, reliable, and delicious!!!!!!!!!!

author: dannab14
text: I love this ice. I think You will love this too if you love to eat cookie dough when your not supposed to. This ice cream has an amazing taste that almost taste like the really thing but in ice cream form. I really recommend this ice cream that has a lovely taste.

author: katpereira21
text: Honestly Ive made it pretty clear that anything with some kind of dough in it is absolutely amaaaazing! Ive just come to associate Ben and Jerrys with it by now. Its there known good. Their identity which is why I like this ice cream in addition to all the others.

author: alic40
text: I only ever get cookie dough ice cream from Ben and Jerrys! They actually came to my college this past spring semester and were handing out free ice cream and thankfully I had the last scoop of cookie dough because it has so much cookie dough in it and I love it!

author: taliao5
text: I love this ice cream because it has the perfect amount of all the components of this as it is on the package theres not just more cookie dough or less cookie dough and not always vanilla ice cream as a perfect amount of chocolate chip cookie dough and ice cream.

author: allysonp8
text: Everyone loves a good basic cookie dough ice cream and this one is definitely a great one. My only complaint is that it can be really solid and you have to let it defrost a lot before you can really get into it. Its not the creamiest but it still tastes amazing!

author: tallyv
text: I LOVE ben and Jerrys ice cream! Its honestly my go to when Im craving ice cream, its a little bit pricey but I know its just because the ingredients are real and not fake like some other brands. The flavour and texture is always on par. I definitely recommend!

author: kenzieebritt
text: I am a big fan of anything cookie dough, and this is easily my FAVORITE cookie dough ice cream! Ben and Jerry's always knocks it out of the park with all of their flavors, and they didn't disappoint with this one! I could easily eat a pint of this in 5 minutes.

author: arelyp16
text: DELICIOUS, creamy, sweet and the best part is that it has chunks of cookie dough in it, great product and at a very good and fair price, great for sharing. Would choose this other ice creams thanks to the great flavors it has. I will definitely purchase again.

author: zhya
text: Yum!! Really liked this flavor because cookie dough in ice cream is just great. Polished it off in 3 sittings while watching some netflix and I definitely want to repurchase this. Definitely recommend getting some if you're into chocolate and/or cookie dough.

author: QTgurl224
title: SOFTY

author: myal1
text: I love chocolate chip cookie dough and Ben and Jerrys does it best with theirs. The ice cream is tasty, and there is the perfect amount of cookie dough and chocolate chip in the ice cream. I buy this brand when getting cookie dough ice cream 80% of the time.

author: taylorc16
text: This so so good for movie nights. I bought one for me and one for my boyfriend for an outdoor movie night. It was delicious. Obviously dont leave this out in the heat for an extended period of time. But this whole brand is fantastic they support BLM Movement

author: christiannar2

author: kathyt40
text: This is, hands down, my absolute favorite ice cream I have ever tried!!! Brownie Chunks and cookie dough mixed together in generous sized pieces with a smooth delicious ice cream. I could eat my body weight in this stuff! It's the best thing in the world!!!

author: tzintlya
text: This was super good. They are really good for a picnic or hot day. I love the portion and it helps me to eat an entire gallon of ice cream. I love the pieces of cookie dough. I have bought this many times. I would buy this again. I recommend this to anyone.

author: memberabfe7
text: This is the only ice cream brand i enjoy. My favourite is the chocolate chip cookie dough, because it's a surprise in every bite, you never know if you're going to get a chip or a piece of dough. Def delicious and would continue to eat this yummy ice cream.

author: abi_auck
text: This is it, folks. I have tried every other cookie dough ice cream and all fall short of Ben and Jerrys. I will say, though, make sure your pint is fresh. It makes all the difference in the taste of the cookie dough chunks. They get hard and crumbly If old.

author: ryann4
text: Classic. Most people judge chocolate chip cookie dough by the cookie dough but to me it all depends on the vanilla ice cream - what good is anything if theres a poor foundation! Amazing vanilla ice cream and love that chocolate chips are too big like some.

author: katelynb73f7
text: I am a huge sucker for ben and Jerrys chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream. It is so smooth and not super milky. A small pint last me a for a few days. Since is sweet i can only have a small amount at a time. It is a bit on the pricey side but so worth it

author: diaundradabney
text: I love cookie dough lol.. I know ally of people can say this. But when you add ice cream (if follow me youll know I love ice cream anything, unless its an overload.) its even better though. [product:ben-&-jerrys-ice-cream-chocolate-chip-cookie-dough-16oz]

author: taym10
text: SO GOOD! Rich, decadent and creamy! Great flavors, not over the top sweet and those chunks of cookie dough are beyond mouth watering! It is a little pricey, but it's so good that sometimes I dont mind treating myself and splurging on it! A great size too!

author: nicolen99
text: I love this when I dont want a lot of ice cream I can usually eat this in two days but it gives me just the right amount. I love getting this when I want some but dont wanna buy a whole tub. Its expensive for such a small container but definitely worth it

author: kikim18

author: jordoncoxx

author: member05c731

author: yaymejess
text: The perfect size! You can find this ice cream at most grocery stores, and it definitely hits the spot. It has the perfect amount of chocolate chip and cookie dough. Its not overly sweet and pretty much perfect. Would definitely recommend this ice cream.

author: yanibellp
text: I love cookie dough ice cream and this Ben and Jerrys chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream is perfect for when you want a sweet treat. The cookie dough chunks in this are soft and perfectly combined with the ice cream creaminess. Definitely a favorite!

author: jkranjac
text: This is my go to brand and flavor. Ben & Jerrys has such high quality products and a large variety to choose from as well. I love the huge chocolate chip cookie dough bites in each pint. Real cookie dough bites and with a rich creamy vanilla ice cream.

author: everythingbeauty786

author: emmakate_02
text: This is one of the best ice creams to exist in this entire world, and to be honest, universe! An amazing ice cream to eat straight out of the jar while crying to a sappy romantic movie haha. Definitely Ben and Jerry's best ice cream flavor out there!

author: kellyc169
text: Love the Ben and Jerry's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Ice Cream. Sometimes we add a little milk to make a milkshake out of it. It is definitely one of our favorite flavors. It does tend to be on the pricey end, but great for a special occasion treat.

author: itssydni
text: My go too ice cream. I love it so much that my boyfriend will randomly just buy it and put it in the freezer for me to surprise me. Im actually eating it as I write this review! I like to spice it up sometimes by adding caramel and rainbow sprinkles.

BEST ICE CREAM EVER!!!!! It has the perfect amount of cookie dough and the vanilla ice cream is to die for. The pint is the perfect amount. It lasts me from three to seven days. This ice cream is more pricey than others but it is definitely worth it.

author: rs426
text: This is one of my all time favorite ice creams. The base is a creamy vanilla flavor but with a toffee flavor like a real chocolate chip cookie. The chunks of cookie dough are substantial and abundant which I love. This is best cookie dough ice cream.

author: emilyoc7fc
text: Ben & Jerry;s chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream is delicious. I don't normally purchase this flavor because my favorite flavor of this brand is Phish Food. The company has strong morals and I feel comfortable buying from them. Worth the calories!

author: msaxd
text: This is currently my favorite chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream! It's delicious and fresh. The distribution of cookie dough to ice cream is perfect! It's pricey so I only buy when it's on sale but it is my favorite! I can't wait to repurchase it!

author: kalynnm

author: kats6

author: alisab0acd

author: thiviyar

author: msnyder2

author: sakinab2
text: One of the classics is a good chocolate chip cookie dough flavored ice cream. This one from Ben and Jerry's by far has to be favorite ice creams. They are a little pricey for a pint but definitely worth it, overall i'm satisfied with this flavor.

author: nickiestclair

author: lopedigobeauty

author: wednesdaim

author: ldey1

author: afa1
text: A classic! Can't go wrong with this flavor. Lots of cookie dough in there -- good ratio of dough to vanilla! I've had this maybe 2-3 times. Wouldn't always purchase this because it is really really sweet but as a once-in-a-while-buy I'd get it.

author: ayaank
text: It's great. It's also vegan if you are dairy free. I am personally not a vegan but I still think it's their best flavor. It's also cheaper than some of the other flavor. I love eating this with cookies. Absolutely delicious. I highly recommend.

author: isobeldm
text: I love chocolate chip cookie dough anything!! So easily this one is my favorite!! You guys have to go pick up a container of this one for yourself! You wont regret the decision!! Any of their ice cream you choose is gonna be amazing regardless!

author: ncwarren80w

author: katied167

author: justicem8

author: jaeb8

author: dogatefish

author: clarisseashley
text: One of my go-tos when Im in the mood for ice cream. Not too sweet, and it has a good amount of cookie dough bits and chocolate. This is definitely a must have just to keep in the freezer for those days when you need something cool and sweet.

author: taylorjobeauty

author: kassandra_pastor

author: courtneyfaith___

author: citygirl98
title: The absolute best

author: Please fix your brownies
title: Crumbly brownies three times!
text: He past three times I have bought the chocolate fudge brownie flavor the brownies have been hard and crumbly. The soft chewy brownies and the best part and three times now I have been let down. Each purchase was made several months apart, hoping the quality control issue was fixed. Nope. They were purchased and Walmart twice and Walgreens the most recent time. This was my absolute favorite ice cream flavor, but I think I’m done wasting $5 on being disappointed each time. Ben and Jerry’s, please figure this out. I saw that you commented that this happens when the ice cream melts and refreezes. You really need to contact your vendors and get this worked out.

author: EBGC03
title: Simply the best
text: I’m dealing with an ice cream addiction right now, I’m eating a pint of chocolate fudge brownie everyday, I know it’s crazy and expensive but it’s the only coping skill that works for me right now, I just love love this ice cream.

author: HappyMomCM
title: Sad Pellets of Yuck
text: I am so sorry to say goodbye to one of my favorite indulgences. In the past, I have made milkshakes and malts out of this ice cream because it's flavor was luscious and indulgent. Sadly, what I purchased today at my local grocery was not. Instead of yummy, chewy, chocolatey brownie bites; it contained gritty pellets of yuck. Each pellet was fairly uniform in size, and unfortunate in taste. Maybe some day I will be able to get this memory behind me and step foot into a Ben and Jerry's shop and see if their ice cream looks something like what is shown in the picture. Then again, after what I tasted today, maybe not.

author: andiinnashville
title: Same issue with the crumbly brownie
text: This is our favorite flavor and the last 3 cartons we’ve purchased have had the same issue of the brownie being crumbly and gritty. We love this flavor so we’re hoping this can get resolved soon! here’s a photo of what we’re seeing in these last 3 cartons.

author: Djmomjeans
title: I miss the old brownies.
text: Chocolate fudge brownie is my absolute favorite! A few months ago a bought a pint and there was only one giant hunk of hard crumbly brownie in the center, I couldn't even eat it. I was disappointed but thought it was a freak thing. Since then I have tried it again from different stores, and different flavors i.e. Half baked and the chocolate fudge brownie pint slices. Again the brownies have been crumbly and chalky. And there weren't many brownie pieces in the them or any fudge swirls. I hope they change the brownies back to the way they were so I can enjoy my favorite treat again!

title: Only thing I wanted after having my baby
text: So disappointed! I struggled with gestational diabetes and was unable to indulge in sweet treats for my whole pregnancy. When I gave birth to our sweet baby boy, I was allowed to have my Ben & Jerry's again. The store was out of half baked so my husband brought me fudge brownie. Couldn't even get through a proper bite because the brownies were just a crumbly/icy mess and the ice cream was sticky and solidified. I thought it had expired but it's good until Sept 2018! I was so upset. I'm afraid to have him go buy more pints if this is the result. I keep hearing about their new flavors but I waited 9 months for a regular pint and it was thrown in the trash-my husband couldn't even stomach it and he eats everything.

author: Miss Pettinato 55
title: Chocolate fudge brownie
text: This ice cream is the best chocolate ice cream in the world, now I am a chocolate lover and I also love ice cream i love trying new flavors and also new restaurants. Ever since I have tryed Ben and Jerrys ice cream I never thought i would find another ice cream that would beat it, and you know what I have not found a better one... and I probably never will. I am only 25 but I have traveled ALOT. I lived in Amsterdam for 3 years and I have tasted and tryed many different chocolate ice creams all arownd Europe and nothing even comes close. I am now back in the US and I still have yet to find a better ice cream. ❤️❤️❤️ If your in a chocolatly mood and need a fix Ben and Jerrys is the ice cream for you!!!

author: FuzzyGut
title: One of my favorites!
text: The brownies! My god the brownies are so GOOD! I’m sorry some don’t enjoy them but I just ate my second pint of this flavor and it’s become a favorite. The ice cream is rich and delicious of course, but the brownies are ridiculously good! Just the right flavor and chewiness. I could eat this for days on end. Please keep this one alive!

author: Phish Food Fan
title: How I love thee!
text: I love the brownies in this ice cream. I’m fact I love them so much that I bought a batch from the company Ben and Jerry’s uses! I eat this flavor more often than I should admit and I LOVE it. Chewy yummy brownies in delicious chocolate ice cream! Can’t lose. I’m sorry so many of you don’t like these new brownies but that just leaves more for me!

author: Goldriley
title: Brownie woes
text: This flavor used to be a favorite of mine, but the last few times I have purchased this flavor over the past few months, no matter what store, the ice cream itself has been great...but the brownie chunks were dry and crumbly! I had purchased Half Baked as well, and the brownie chunks were AMAZING!! I hope something can be figured out so it can be a return to being in my good graces again!!

author: Chrissy
title: Chocolate Fudge Brownie
text: Im huge fan of Ben & Jerry's and normally Im a Phish food gal! Decided to try this Flavour as had 7 year old nephew staying and Brownies are his favourite desert also any excuse to indulge in a major choc feast! but was SO disappointed in this ice-cream ! was clumpy and brownies where so hard and dry?!!! Shame a let from all the other flavours ..boohoo.

author: PatTuz
title: What's happened?
text: Every so often I'd buy a pint of "CFB" as my kids' and I refer it, and the brownies would be hard, crumbly, and tasteless....a real disappointment. I just attributed it to "a batch that melted on the way to the supermarket" or something. However, now, when we really need it, I bought 5 pints, and all are hard, tasteless and crumbly. I can't believe that I have to say "bye-bye"to B&J's CFB.

author: Mari
title: Very Sad
text: Ever since I was young, this has always been my favorite ice cream. I've always bought this ice cream and ate it as a comfort food. However, recently i've found that I can't enjoy this ice cream like I used to, because of the disgusting little chunks of hardness in the brownie bits. There's nothing more insulting than biting into a "great baked good" and instead having your teeth grit because of the inability to chew the extremely hard pieces in the brownie. I thought maybe it was a one time thing, so I bought another container. The second container had the exact same issue. This is truly a major let down, because this is the only store bought ice cream I've ever liked I hope they can fix this issue soon.

author: Disappointed625
title: Disappointing
text: I have had this flavor from time to time pretty much since it was first made available, so I am familiar with the level of quality it can have. In fact, take a look at your pic compared to mine--totally different experiences as your pic represents what I am accustomed to enjoying and mine is a poor copycat version with crumbly bits of what appear to be and taste like inadequately mixed brownie pieces. Honestly, the ice cream would have been better without the add-ins. After reading other customers' experiences, I think I am going to write this one off my favorites list.

author: Melanie
title: I noticed you must read and fix issues????????
text: My girlfriend and I got some of this ice cream all because it’s her favorite. She dug into it to find dry, gross brownies. We were like what? Went and bought another thinking the first must have frozen wrong or something. She dug into it and it as well was the same way. I love Ben and Jerry’s ice cream. I will go out of my way to get some. But now I’m rethinking this. The reviews go on and on for several years worth. If you don’t fix a problem that’s been on going, how am I sure the rest of your ice cream isn’t going to have problems like this. Sorry but I just can’t chance it.

author: Rosex
title: Fix your brownies!!
text: This has always been one of my favorite Ben & Jerry's flavors. However the last two times I have bought it, the brownies have been crumbly and not fudgey?? Not sure what happened to the batter but the brownies are flaky and hard chunks. Very disappointed!

author: becca
title: Was my favorite until.....
text: Had a huge craving for Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Fudge Brownie Ice Cream. I have been eating Ben & Jerry's for quite some time now. Today I purchased it and must have bought a bad batch. The "fudge brownie" pieces were dry, crumbly, and tan in color-not like usual! It didn't taste like the normal batch either- I was so sad because after 2 bites I just couldn't handle it anymore. I just bought it today and it wasn't even close to the Expiration date either. Disappointed :(

author: Tally
title: Disappointed
text: The chocolate ice cream itself is very good but the last couple pints I've bought all had hard brownie bites. They're so dry they crack as soon as you bite into them.

author: insiduous1
title: This is my new favorite
text: I normally get Half-Baked, but I was craving actual chocolate ice cream (which is kinda rare for me; I prefer vanilla), so I asked my husband to get me some and he showed up with this. Omgosh. It's better than Half-Baked! Usually I want more brownies in the HB because it always seems (to me) to be 2/3 cookie dough and 1/3 brownie. And this really hit the spot. The only problem is...I ate the whole pint in one sitting, which is, uh, not something I typically do and definitely not healthy. lol. I'll be sure to stop at least halfway through next time. :)

author: Popicoser
title: Used to be my favorite, but...
text:
This flavour used to be my favorite ice cream of all times, but the last few pints I bought were really disappointing.
Bought in CVS, the brownie bits were really hard and dry, and they used to be so moist and soft!!
So sad. RIP fudge brownie :(

author: LAE13
title: Brownie bites were hard and crusty..
text: This was my favorite flavor and the last few pints I bought were very disappointing. The ice cream is delicious but the what use to be fudgie brownie bites are now hard can crusty. Like they are old and frost bite... so sad :(

author: Scook
title: Disappointed
text: Since I was a child Chocolate Fudge Brownie was my all time favorite ice cream until one day I bought it and the brownies were hard, crumbly, gross...I hoped it was a fluke yet every single time I buy it it's still disgusting. I stopped getting it for a while and switched to Half baked....the brownies were hard AGAIN even in that. Now I've been forced to buy other brands but none can even compare to what once was the best ice cream known to man. Sadly not anymore.

author: Sara
title: Awful brownies!!
text: I was hoping this was a fluke thing but reading the other reviews it seems not. I’ve purchased 3 pints in the last six months or so and they were absolutely delicious! Soft chewy brownie pieces and wonderful ice cream. However this time the brownies are awful. They are rock hard rectangular chunks I can barely scoop out and when eating them they are just dry, hard, and crumbly. Not worth the $5!!!! I probably won’t try again as this seems to be an ongoing issue for other customers as well. It was my favourite ice cream:(

author: TayTayE
title: Really disappointed :(
text: I bought a pint of this ice cream from my local drug store and I just have to say how utterly dissatisfied I am on the quality of the ice cream I have been eating this brownie flavor for the past 4 years with no problem and I have always been a loyal customer of Ben & Jerry's so I'm sad to say that for the first time I am very unsatisfied hopefully you'll be able to make it up. And to pin point the problem area, the brownies were burnt and dry.

author: Freddiegee
title: What used to be
text: I have been buying this for a long time but it's not the same anymore. you guys have the best chocolate ice cream but the brownies have totally declined lately. I know you can blame retailers but that doesn't cut it anymore. it's not their fault. Take the heat yourselves and do something about it.

author: mpc2000
title: What happened to this ice cream?
text: We bought 2 pints last night, chocolate fudge brownie and coffee toffee crunch. We haven't had any Ben and Jerry's in a few years. Chocolate fudge brownie used to be my absolute favorite. We each tried one bite and all hated it. The brownies were hard and the ice cream tasted really weird. The coffee toffee crunch wasn't much better. I guess they changed the ingredients. Doesn't taste like a premium ice cream. It's not even as good as a cheap ice cream! Definitely won't buy again!

author: Michael G
title: So disapointed
text: This used to be heaven in a cup. Now the squishy delicious brownie has been reduced to some indescribable light colured crunchy substance that neither looks og tastes like brownie. Surpriced to see the same issue in year old reviews.

author: Melba
title: Totally Torn!!
text: This has been my favorite flavor since it came out. However I’ve recently switched to different flavors because the consistency is very bad regarding the brownie chunks. I understand the issue regarding handling but if you cannot control the quality of your product through your vendors, well that’s concernjng for your product. I look forward to the company regulating handling so I can come back to my beloved flavor. Meanwhile, your other flavors are definitely keeping me busy!!

author: Marissak
title: So disappointed
text: I haven't had any of these ice creams in about 8 or 9 months and to celebrate my nephews birthday I took him to get one since I don't get to see him besides every couple months. Well when we got home for his party he took a bite and immediately spit it out. So i tried it and noticed it just didn't taste the same and the brownies were either overcooked just not made correctly. It's such a shame because this was my favorite brand but I can't afford the price for it just to be thrown in the trash :(

author: Kris0909
title: Yuck
text: This ice cream used to be my absolute favorite!!! Now every time I have gotten some the brownies are hard and crumbly. I've even tried different stores, different states and now we are stationed in Germany and we still get the hard crumb brownie :( I miss the yummy fudge brownie

author: Shalom
title: VERY AVERAGE....
text: Certainly not worth $8! never again.................

author: alex1989
title: Normally I love this ice cream!
text: I buy this ice cream a lot. I notice that half the time it's perfect, lots of big chunks of brownie. The other half, it's hardly any brownie, or it's a whitish color in the brownie and it's crunchy (not how it normally is, which is soft) or the brownie is mushy. So, it's a basically a 50/50 shot of getting my money's worth. I love this ice cream but I'm starting to wonder why this happens?

author: Kandi
title: Ugh
text: I bought one 2 weeks ago and it was amazing! I bought one today and it is disappointing. The brownies are hard and dry. I couldn't even eat them, so I ate the chocolate icecream.

author: sunny23
title: Brownie tasted hard
text: I bought this recently and it used to my favorite. I got it all the time but the last two pints I bought the brownies tasted overcooked. I don't know how they let that slip through quality control. Come on Ben n Jerrys, you guys can do better.

author: caitlinlarkin
title: Used to be the best, not so much anymore
text: This used to be one of my favorite B&J's flavor (right up there with Peanut Butter Cup and Half Baked), but the last two pints I've bought have had super dry, over-cooked brownies. So disappointing when you are expecting delicious, chewy, fudgy brownie chunks. Upon reading other reviews, it seems like this is a common issue, so I don't think I'll be purchasing this flavor again.

author: LBeckett
title: Hard brownies
text: Normally love this flavour, but opened this carton and all the brownies are hard and crumbly. Very disappointed and makes the ice cream not enjoyable

author: PhoenixRises
title: Old Faithful
text: This is a classic favorite! I would buy this ice cream a couple times a week from the convenience store on campus during my college days at George Mason. Whether I was stressed out or just in the mood for something delicious I would turn to old faithful. I stopped eating this flavor for awhile when all the new flavors came in, but no too long ago by husband bought me this by mistake instead of the brownie core (another fav), and I forgot how amazing this ice cream was. I started getting this again. I love brownies, and they're not stingy with the brownie bite size and that's much appreciate. This ice cream was the reason why I fell in love with B&J in the first place, so it will always have a special place in my heart.

author: Jank
title: Hard and crumbly fudge
text: The last 3 jugs of chocolate fudge brownie have been very dissapointing. The texture of the brownie havent been fudgy, but very hard and crumbly... The brownie isent even brown, its more a light brown colour ..

author: lily14
title: Strange
text: This ice cream is usually very good and chocolatey, complete with soft, scrumptious brownies. However, my last purchase of this specific flavor was very disappointing. The brownie bites were hard, grainy, and inedible. The pint has been sitting in the freezer for months, something that is unprecedented in my house Ben and Jerry's lovers.

author: Lgalla25
title: Poor quality recently
text: This is my absolute favourite ice cream and hadn't had it for around 6 months - unfortunately the 2 tubs I have bought recently have had light coloured, chalky/crumbly dried out brownie in them - very disappointed :-( the chocolate ice cream tastes ok, just the quality of the brownies seems to have deteriorated.

author: Camcam
title: What's happened to the quality control on this fla
text: I love this flavor when the brownie are fudge bu over the last several years about 50% of the time I get the graining yucky stuff that I think is supposed to be the brownies. Please fix the problem.

author: beach patty
title: Not what it use to be!
text: The only ice cream I've eaten for years is the Chocolate Fudge Brownie. Was always my absolute favorite but lately the brownies are light colored and crunchy and so disgusting that I have thrown most of the last few containers out. Have you changed something? I noticed you said that it could be from improper handling and refreezing. If that was the case I think the ice cream would have ice crystals in it. For the price of over $5 I will have to reconsider brands of ice cream. I don't mind paying the price but lately it's just not worth it. I'm sooo sad.

author: Madday
title: Amazing chocolate!
text: I LOVE!!! This ice cream. It took my husband a few yrs to even convince me to try it. Result..... pure weekly addiction. However- the last few pints we have purchased (one for him one for me) have had SUPER dried out,almost cracker like, brownie chuncks. Not at all the ice cream I've come to love and crave. Don't know if maybe a bad batch, quality control, or recipes??? Anyway, hoping the good ole amazing-ness will return. I would still tell my friends this is amazing Icecream with a proviso that it's been not stellar lately.

author: Lejla
title: Not like it used to be...
text: I used to get this flavor ALL the time. I loved it. It satisfied all my chocolate cravings.... buuuut... I haven't gotten it in a while. Until yesterday. It tasted fine until I got to the brownie part. It felt like it was dried out, hard, and even had a crunch to it. I love the Milk & Cookies flavor (so I guess I'll stick to that), but unfortunately I won't be buying this flavor again.

author: Jackiefromcalifornia
title: The queen of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream
text: Good lord, I use to LOVE This ice cream. I would pay $8.99 at gas stations if I craved it and I was away from home. It was always worth the extra money even when it came to the minis. I don’t know what’s happening with the company though, the ice cream is becoming a hit or miss. Sometimes my brownies are so soft and delicious and other times they are dry and hard to chew. It’s terrible. Just last week they were doing buy 5 and get them for $3.99 each, so best believed I bought ten because what a steal.or so I thought..... Well turns out that was a mistake because I have opened three containers and they are extremely dry and hard. Hope they see all these reviews and improve its quality. because girlfriend over here wants to love the ice cream again!

author: Kvb1982
title: Hard brownie
text: I bought this and was really excited to try it but when I did the brownies were a weird light brown color and hard. The brownies crumbled into what looked like dirt.

author: DC24
title: A Go-To Chocolate Ice Cream!
text: I don't normally go for rich chocolate flavors, but this is one of my favorites when I do. It has a wonderfully rich, creamy, cake-like texture. Perfect smoothness and a delightful chocolaty brownie flavor set this ice cream apart from most chocolate ice cream. If you have a hankering for simple pure chocolate fudge brownie goodness, then this flavor is for you!

author: Joseph1813
title: Very Disappointing...
text: Bought this flavor twice in the last 2 days... Yesterday the ice cream was fantastic ate the entire pint me and my wife. But tonight we had our second pint.. The ice cream had lots of crystals all over it, the brownies were crusty it was so bad i checked the expiration date thinking it was expired. Not very happy considering this is a $5 pint of ice cream...

title: Bad brownies
text:
A few months ago, I noticed the brownies from 2 specific exp. Dates, were hard, dry and appeared stale. As someone whos has ate a pint a day of chocolate fudge brownie icecream from b&j for over a year now (a bit much) I was disappointed, and unable to eat them. At $6. A pint, I wasted alot of money for about 6 weeks. I had to travel out of town to get different dates.
New batches came and they have improved , however I still find the occasional stale brownie.
When the brownies are normal, the icecream is fantastic.

author: Edstromp
title: A favourite for years!
text: I like many flavours of B&J but I tend to turn back to this one. Mmmm... the combination Chocolate Fudge Brownie, some salty potato crisps (and maybe some adulty beverage) is so freaking good a friday night that it can make even the worst of weeks look like a faint crack in some old pants you anyway had thought of throwing away. Mmm mm mmm....

author: MM33
title: Extremely disappointing
text: I loved this ice cream flavor ever since middle school! Now the last time I've bought it the brownie is crusty and nasty ! It not only is disappointing after I sit down after a extremely long day go enjoy a sweet treat that use to be very delicious- and now it's just chocolate with chunks of dry crusty brownie bites !! Waste of money

author: Cree
title: Good ice cream, nasty brownies
text: I'm in shock. Ben and Jerry's has let me down for the second time. They used to have such delicious ice cream! The ice cream itself was good, but the brownie chunks were terrible! They tasted more like a ball of slightly cocoa mostly flour. Even the cheapest ice creams get the brownie chunks to taste like... brownies. Epic fail.

author: Love Brownies
title: Please Bring Back Better Brownies!
text: I have been a fan of this flavor & eating 1 pt a week for last 3 yrs. The last 4 months I have been buying from Neighborhood Walmart in St Matthews Ky & Kroger nearby & unfortunately this ice cream..my escape has not been as good :(

author: Mike
title: Crusty brownies!
text: I have stood by this flavor for so long thinking I just had bad luck but the past few times its been the same! Freezer burn chalky crusty brownies and an all around bad flavor. I can see I'm not alone. I've tried multiple stores and it seems like there is no bias for quality! To bad it really is the best flavor in my opinion

author: porter6547
title: Not the same
text: I always get this ice cream flavor. It is my favorite. I bought it three times within the last month and each time it contiued to disappoint me. The brownies were hard and scarce and the ice cream tasted weird and of chemical odor. So disappointed because it is my favorite flavor and I was a dedicated buyer. :((((((((((((((

author: James193850790
title: Brownies are gummy!
text: Used to be my favorite before they released the brownie batter ice cream (RIP).. now the brownies are so gummy that they are unedible! I literally eat the ice cream and spit out the brownies they are so bad :( I wish they would release the brownie batter ice cream again as that was a much better ice cream overall.

author: Gtrman84
title: What happened?
text: Ben and Jerry's chocolate fudge brownie ice cream was once one of my favorite things. A treat that was worth looking forward to. The brownies used to be delicious, now they are dried crumbles of tan funk. I don't buy that the poor state of said brownies is due to a freeze thaw cycle. What happened? Really??

author: Sarah0192837
title: Disappointing and inedible :(
text: I just bought a pint of this because I was desperately craving ice cream and it was disgusting. This used to be my favorite flavor, and I'd buy it all the time last summer, but the brownies this time were all white and crumbly and the whole experience was so gross that it was completely inedible. I wanted this ice cream so badly and it was such a let down. And now I see that this is a common problem and has been for years. Not buying again; it's not worth spending $4 a pint for this kind of risk. Buyer beware.

author: Karitx
title: Brownies might as well be rocks
text: This used to be the best flavor they had - moist and chewy brownies. For the last 10 years, they've sucked. Every so often, you'll get a decent pint, but mostly they are inedible. I've contacted B&J a few times and they never sent what they promised, I've stopped buying this completely.

author: Priya R
title: Ugh! Hard, inedible brownies
text: This used to be my favorite ice cream, bar none. But every other pint I buy now has the same problem - the brownies are hard, chalky and just BAD. They used to be consistently soft and delicious...think I'll have to stop buying this altogether, though it breaks my heart.

author: EmmaN
title: Almost no brownies and they are hard :(
text: Used to love this flavour and I bought a couple pints the other day, there were almost no brownie bits in either of them and the ones that were there were hard and crusty :( if the recipe changed for any reason, please bring back the old one. I love my Ben and Jerry's!

author: Kbuggs
title: Taking care of customers
text: My fiance and I are very big fans of Ben & Jerry's especially this flavor. It's something we get to share together at night when we're alone. A week ago we had an issue with his ice cream and we hate to complain but it was an issue that really freaks out my fiance. Today we received a refund and 5 free coupons for whatever we wanted. This was a shock to him and I but was very much appreciated. It nice to see how much you care about your customers. We both thank you very much and will always be a fan!! :)

author: briski
title: Still can't find a better chocolate brownie flavor

Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Fudge Brownie is my very favorite ice cream, bar none.

author: Nessyrae23
title: Finally a chocolate ice cream for chocolate lovers
text: I love chocolate and I love ice cream but that doesn't mean I like chocolate ice cream. Who else hates when you open up a carton of chocolate ice cream and it's light tan and you know the flavor will be as weak as the color and you know before you take your first bite you'll be disappointed? I kind of gave up on ice cream for a long time because of that. It wasn't until I got a job at a Ben and jerrys scoop shop and saw how dark their chocolate fudge brownie ice cream is that I decided to try it. At that point I wasn't much of an ice cream eater and if wasn't called triple dark chocolate fudge I didn't want to try it and be disappointed. When I took my first bite I was really blown away by how rich and deep the flavor was. This is the way chocolate ice cream should be. It should be indulgent and intoxicating and not for the faint hearted. Then you add in the super moist and delicious brownies and it just doesn't get any better than that. Now I can't eat a lot of this. One scoop is enough bc it is so indulgent. I have to be in the mood for it. This is my go to when I've had a bad day and I need comfort. Since I tried this I have become a loyal Ben and jerrys customer. The scoop shop closed a while back which is sad because it was a cool place. But bottom line is Ben and jerrys are the only brand that makes real chocolate ice cream the way it should be made

text: The pint slices are amazing! Better than the pint!

author: Scoopy sue
title: Just perfect
text: Delicious refreshing base, outstanding marshmallow swirl and yummy truffles - I love this flvaour!

author: BabyDontGo
title: Spot on...again!
text: Love this! I am a lover of Ben & Jerry's, have been for as long as I can remember and while some flavors are not typically my thing, this one is awesome! With the ice cream you get a smooth, creamy and full bodied chocolate malt ice cream, combined with a beautifully whipped marshmallow fluff type swirl. The ice cream mixed with this smooth heavenly marshmallow swirl would be enough for me but the addition of the cookie crumbled covered fudge bits, its joygasmic! Everything about this is a win, I really hope that this flavor stays around for a long time. If you want a smooth, creamy, satisfying chocolate ice cream....well, this one is for you!

author: Pnw1989
title: Love the truffles not the regular as much
text:
Didn't realize there is a Chocolate Shake it and. Chocolate Shake it Truffles. The Truffles version is hands downs better. The difference being that one has salted fudge bits and one has cookie covered truffle bits. The truffles are gooey are delicious. The fudge is dry and chewy.
Other than that I love everything else about it, malted ice cream with marshmallow is perfect combo. Not to rich and I can eat a whole pint without being sick! Haha probably not a good thing.

author: eastwest
title: This is my dream flavor
text: Where to begin. The explosive marshmallows? The creamy chocolate? The chewy truffles?

author: Cree
title: Disappointed
text: Something has gone terribly wrong at Ben & Jerry's. After my 2nd disappointing pint from them I was really hoping for a win. This flavor was incredibly bland. You can't call something chocolate malt just because it is light brown. I could not detect any malt flavor whatsoever and could barely taste chocolate. Even then I think it may have just been the truffles. The truffles were ok and there were plenty, but even the marshmallow swirl was also bland. Sweet tasting and I liked the soft texture but none of the flavors that were supposed to be in this were! Unfortunately I forgot to use my coupon and paid for this junk.

author: KirstenBuckeye
title: Hoped for more marshmallow and truffles!
text: I am eating a pint of it right now and the ice cream is delicious. I wish the truffles weren’t as sparse though and wish there were more marshmallow swirl. I’m about halfway through the pint and can still hardly see any marshmallow.

author: NaeWavyGravy
title: Disappointed
text: I bought this a couple of days ago and to be honest that's a long time to have Ben & Jerry's in the house. This one really isn't for me. I don't like it at all. It doesn't really taste like a chocolate milkshake to me more of a chocolate malted base with a lite marshmallow swirl. The truffle could be a little smaller which would make it have more also I'd they were a darker chocolate or a richer chocolate maybe it would be better I'm not sure but this one doesn't work for me.

author: Kaya
title: Bland and Odd Texture
text: This one missed the mark for me. I understand the texture is meant to be more like a milkshake but I expected something different and it felt grainy. The flavor was bland for me, almost no milk chocolate flavor, closer to sweet cream. Even the marshmallow swirl was nothing like the S'mores swirl, it had a very artificial texture. The truffles were pretty good, but not as much cookie crunch as I expected and there weren't many of them. Overall, I'm disappointed. I love Ben and Jerry's but this one did not live up to the label.

author: bgdl26
title: Loved it but needs more truffles
text: I've been obsessed with Tonight Dough for years and have yet to find a new flavor that I like as much until this one! I loved it! Tastes like a chocolate milk shake, love the marsh-mellow swirl and the cookie covered truffles were amazing, I just wish there were more in my pint. It seemed like I only had 4 or 5 but clearly there should be a lot more based on the photo. Anyway, it's still amazing.

author: NotAChocoholic
title: Average and Boring
text: This may just be my anger speaking becuase I asked for one thing for Valentine's Day: Caramel Chocolate Cheesecake truffle. And what do I get? The most average chocolate icecream you can possibly from the Ben and Jerry's section of the freezer aisle. If you're gonna spend your money on something expensive, spend it on something good and flavorful.

author: Chicksluvrock
title: Good, but not great
text: I was very excited to try this flavor, and although it was good, it isn’t as good as I thought it would be. The texture of the ice cream is wonderfully creamy, but I would have liked a more intense malty-chocolatey flavor....it’s pretty mild. The marshmallow swirls and truffles are tasty though....except mine could of used more truffles! Overall good but I think I’ll stick with my favorite flavor - peanut butter world!

author: Chocolover779
title: Unimpressed
text: Overall I wasn’t impressed with this flavor, while it is very sweet, there isn’t much chocolate flavor. I don’t care for the fudge morsels either, they’re quite dry. The marshmallow is the best part! I will go back to Chocolate Therapy for my next pint.

author: Jasper02
title: Will not purchase again
text: Very bland ice cream and truffles. The only good thing was the marshmallow swirl, of which there was not enough. Only had about 1 tablespoon of marshmallow and 5 truffles in the whole pint.

author: Ice cream man
title: Yummy
text: Creamy smooth Malt ice cream! Need I say more? I think it’s a great idea no ice cream company ( at least in my area) sells malt ice cream so I’m happy Ben and Jerry’s came out with this!

author: Carrie999
title: My new favorite!
text: I love everything about this new flavor! I ordered it online and it arrived today. I told myself that I would just try a bit and now I can’t stop eating it!

author: samanthapaige
title: Underwhelmed
text: I was excited to try this but it fell short. Weird texture, off taste, the truffles were not good. Disappointed! Will stick with my Half Baked from now on.

author: zoey
title: not worth the calories
text: the chocolate ice cream was okay.... nothing to rave about, but the marshmallow swirls didn’t taste like anything. the truffles were very sparse, there were only like 5 of them in the entire pint and i wasn’t a fan of the taste or texture. this flavor pint just didn’t work for me. i usually love ben & jerrys but kinda just wanted to throw this one out while eating it.

author: Hayls
title: Kind of bland
text: The truffles were extremely bland. The ice cream & marshmallow swirl were good but it was just lacking in overall flavor & chunks

author: SarahSS
title: Tastes like a milkshake!
text: I had to try one of the new flavors, they looked so tempting! The ice cream flavor in this is so delicious and tastes like you're drinking a malt milkshake. There's a lot of marshmallow (my favorite part) and a good amount of truffles, not TOO many but certainly not sparse. I will definitely purchase again, but only after I try the other two new ones!!

author: AllD
title: This is everything I've ever wanted in icecream
text: I found this flavor yesterday after not buying ice-cream in a while. IT IS AMAZING. It tastes like you're eating a perfectly made milkshake. There's a little bit of some dryer flavor in the chocolate-cookie covered fudge but it levels out the entire flavor (one of the gripes I have with half baked is that it is too rich / gooey) and the marshmallow swirls tie it all together. Please never get rid of this and if you do let me know so I can stock up forever.

author: Turtledark
title: A whole lot of meh
text: Bought this a few days ago after finally finding it again. Maybe I built the flavors up in my head but for a Ben and Jerry's flavor, this seriously lacked. I LOVE malt, marshmallow, and truffles but it was just so bland. I tasted no malt but the ice cream was really creamy. The light chocolate taste was nice. The marshmallow was pretty consistent with every other flavor that includes it. I'm a major fish food fan. The truffles were what I had been looking forward to the most. I really liked the ones in the chillin the roast flavor. The truffles in this though had NO flavor! The only chocolate hint I tasted was from the thin coating; definitely not a "cookie crunch". Needless to say, I was disappointed. It wasn't bad. I mean, I love ice cream! I just really wish there was a real taste. If I wanted to vanilla, I would have gotten vanilla.

author: Dumb
title: They changed the fudge pieces
text: This used to be my all time favorite ice cream. Bought tons every time it was on sale, gobbled it down and then bought more at full price. Love love loved it. Until they changed the cookie covered fudge pieces. Apparently the new fudge pieces are salted and it destroys what this ice cream used to be about. That cookie crust was so well done and the fudge melted in your mouth. For whatever reason Ben and Jerry’s has decided to stop making a superior product. Instead they cop out and use salt to pique people’s taste buds. We don’t need more salt in our lives or diets! Bring back the original fudge pieces and make this ice cream great again! I can barely eat it since I discovered the unnecessary and “wool over our eyes” awful salted fudge mix up.

author: Tomas
title: No No No!
text: Picked up about 10 various flavors the other day and "Chocolate Shake It" was by far the worst. It was awful! Kept thinking it would get better as I ate, but gave up and tossed the last half away. I'll stick with my "Tonight Dough".

author: Laurenisawesome
title: Get the Phish Food instead
text: The malt ice cream flavor is good, the cookie truffles are what brings the whole ice cream down. The truffles are bitter and too big. The size keeps it frozen and hard. The marshmallow swirl is amazing though. Then again why not just have the Phish Food which I think is similar but has the caramel to make it even better.

author: Breezyj
title: Excellence!
text: I often feel a twinge of guilt purchasing Ben & Jerry’s over our many local brands, but yet again, the thoughtful, indulgent flavor combos are a league of their own.

author: KaitlynC
text: I was extremely excited when I bought this icecream, and don’t regret it, the only thing I did not like about it was the chocolate truffles. They were extremely hard, and I felt like they were unnecessary in the icream. Other than that, the icecream was great, the taste was amazing, the marshmallow was great. 50/50

title: Absolutely love it!
text: I personally don’t like an overly strong chocolate flavor in my ice cream. I like black and white milkshakes, frozen custard, and chocolate malt because they all have a dialed down chocolate flavor. This ice cream is perfect for me, and the marshmallow is a perfect compliment. Sometimes it’s nice to have cleaner, more subtle flavors as opposed to overwhelming concoctions of bourbon pretzel cheesecake ice cream with peanut butter salted caramel brownie chunks or something equally extra. Really well done!

author: FuzzyGut
title: Yes please!
text: What an awesome new flavor! First off, it really does taste like a chocolate milkshake. It’s light and creamy with the marshmallow swirl and the truffles are yummy too. Good job on this new flavor, B&J! Yum!

author: Just Me
title: Truffles were bitter
text: My least favorite B&J flavor ever! The truffles were almost "whiskey" tasting, strong and bitter. I couldn't even force myself to try and eat it. First time I have ever thrown ice cream away.

author: Andrew1989
title: Bland
text: This flavor is not very good, overall. Its just basic chocolate ice cream with a few dots of marshmellow fluff with these really mealy truffles that taste like nothing- very disappointing.

author: brianaa
title: good but dont like the truffles
text: i loved the chocolate and marshmallow. thought i found the perfect flavor but the truffles tasted off and were too heavy compared to the consistency of the rest of product.

author: Teecee
title: Malt Shake Dreams Come True
text: I love malts so this is so delicious! The truffles are good too along w/ the marshallow bits. It's my favorite B&J's flavor & I hope it never stops getting made :D

author: Girly girl
title: Ice cream perfection
text: I’m hoping this flavor doesn’t disappear because it’s the best I’ve ever tried. Love all the yummy marshmallow creme and decadent truffles!

author: Icecreamfan4life
title: Cool idea but wasn't quite a hit for me
text: Bought this pint and the cheesecake flavor a few days ago(haven't tried the other just yet). Thinking this would be something fun and different to try(even though I'm not a big chocolate ice cream fan aside from Wendy's Frosties). And have to say as I sit here eating it now. The Malt base does remind me of a Wendy's Frosty(which I enjoyed). But I honestly don't think that it pairs all that well with the marshmallow swirl or the cookie truffles(which I've gotten plenty of those and not fully sure if I like them or not. Great texture and pretty soft to munch on. But taste wise may not be my thing).

author: lme2813
title: Used to be delicious
text: We have loved this ice cream for a while and have bought many many pints. Ove the last couple of months I have bought it at different stores and we found some of these are horrible. The truffle pieces look nothing like the picture on this site or what they're supposed to look like. Unfortunately I threw them all away so I don't have one but they're little hard pieces of stale tasting chocolate bits. It ruins the ice cream and I was blaming the store thinking maybe they weren't kept frozen but I found the same thing when I purchased elsewhere. Not sure if it was a problem at the factory or if a change was made to the ice cream but wither way it ruins it and I can't keep wasting money on bad ice cream. I don't mind paying more for good quality but I'm not getting it anymore with this flavor and it's so disappointing.

author: Missa
title: Rich but subtle
text: I have had this flavor twice now and it has hit the spot each time. It's subtle but it has deep flavor. It's very much like biting into a chocolate milkshake. I could do without the marshmallow fluff but it does have a nice texture and it breaks up the heaviness of the ice cream. A lot of people are reviewing that this flavor is bland but I like it. I hope it continues to be an option for years to come because I will be buying a shameful quantity of pints.

author: violet616
title: Great idea!
text: I love a chocolate malt and loved the idea. While I found the ice cream itself to be delightfully creamy, the truffles certainly satisfying and marshmallow cream a pleasant addition I found the overall product to leave a strange aftertaste, so much so that I tossed out the pint after one paltry serving. Disappointing, but I intend to keep trying your new and novel flavors :)

author: Isitdahfridge
title: Is it the stores’ fault?
text: I bought two pints of this flavor, each from a different store, and I was quite surprised. One was from a gas station, the other from a grocery store. The one from the gas station was grainy, but my guess it was just beginning to form ice crystals (maybe the door to their freezer room was slightly open). The one from the grocery store was perfectly smooth (other than the chunks).

author: Jenniferu1
title: Love this!
text: I bought this today and couldnt wait to try it. I can definitely taste the malt in the ice cream. With the marshmallow it reminded me of a mallo cup candy, without the coconut, from years ago but way better as I'm not a fan of coconut. I just had a few bites tonight but plan on putting some hot fudge on it to make a sunday tomorrow and I'm sure it will taste like heaven! I eat in moderation!

author: ChrisColby
title: Good flavor but lacking.
text: A strong malt chocolate base and the marshmallow swirl make for a good set up, but this flavor was really lacking in mix ins. The truffles in my pints were spaced too far apart and with too few in general. This flavor needed more of a bite or crunch (perhaps a second mix in, like cookie crumbs) to reach its full potential. A good flavor (thanks to the base and swirl) but certainly lacking

author: duffy
title: My new favorite
text: In the past month I have bought a pint of this flavor every week. The texture is different to other flavors, more like a milkshake, which to me gives it some novelty and frankly I really like it. The chocolate cookie pieces alone are a little dry but pack great flavor and with the marshmallow swirls which are more liquid and the new texture it works together to make a truly great pint.

author: SusanHop
title: Fabulously delicious!
text: I'm not a fan of marshmallow, but the chocolate malted milkshake ice cream, plus the truffle sold me on trying it. The awesomeness of the marshmallow was a wonderful surprise! The ice cream its self is perfect, though a bit more malt wouldn't go amiss in my opinion :-). The truffles are divine and blend the three ingredients into a satisfying and delicious ice cream experience.

author: Joelle
title: meh
text: The ice cream itself is so good--malty chocolate, perfect. The marshmellow swirl is good and in good ratio but those fudge clusters! They're kind of bitter and just not what I was hoping for. The whole experience ends up being pretty one-note without a fun texture element. This one is so close to great, but unfortunately just not.

author: Kaylazies
title: Best flavor on EARTH
text: Literally my new absolute FAVORITE icecream ever. It’s PERFECT. It’s all my favorite flavors together all in one and that chocolate cookie swirl is to die for and omg that graham cracker is just heaven, not too chocolately and that marshmallow icecream just ties it aallllll together. Amazing. Exquisite. Must have with every meal.

author: Goldberry7
title: Palatable, but awfully bland
text: I agree with other folks remarking on the blandness. There weren't many truffles, but that was actually a good thing since they were tasteless and ruined the bite on my spoon. Since my nightly bowl of B and J's is my only form of pleasure being 8 months pregnant, I felt the need to write a review. Going back to Chocolate Therapy.

author: Brinkley28
title: Save your money!
text: I bought this ice cream from Safeway in Pasadena, MD. I was excited to try it since it was a chocolate ice cream base but man was I wrong. This ice ream had such an odd texture and tasted like ice milk. Like they just added chocolate syrup and like it get freezer brunt, I do not recommend this flavor to anyone!

author: Sarahmuffin37
title: So much marshmallow
text: At first I wasn't excited to try this flavor but as I love anything marshmallow, I tried it. The marshmallow swirl is out of this world! Usually it says marshmallow but you can barely taste it, this product has a good amount of marshmallow that tastes like marshmallow! I would HIGHLY recommend this product!

author: y2flu
title: Surprisingly awesome
text: I'm not a big fan of chocolate ice creams, but I was looking for a new flavor to try and this was the only one they had, so I bought a pint. Wow, is it good! I love the truffles and the marshmallow is awesome. I've bought 3 or 4 more pints since buying the first one, and I'm about to go buy another one.

author: Mewples
title: My new favorite flavor!
text: Whenever I'm craving ice cream this is the first thing I search for now. Others must have the same idea because half of the time its completely sold out at my grocery store! I love that the ice cream itself isnt too sweet which makes the marshmallow a perfect compliment. Please keep this flavor around ~

author: Beeb
title: New changes not welcome
text: I have been eating this flavor and only this flavor since it's release. It was everything I ever wanted in ice cream. This ice cream really needed the crunch from the truffle. And the salt with marshmallow? Ew. It needs the dark chocolate to go with that sugary sweet. So disappointed in the changes.

author: Nicole8
title: TERRIBLE FLAVOR
text:
Upon hearing the name of the flavor, I could not wait to try it!
WHAT A HUGE LET DOWN!!!
It was practically tasteless. The ice cream literally has no taste.
I love Ben and Jerry's ice cream but this truly missed the mark for me. Ill stick to my favorites Americone Dream and Vanilla Caramel Fudge

title: New favorite
text: I bought this because I love malted ice cream and I’m so glad I did. It’s delicious on its own but the addition of the marshmallow swirl and fudge covered cookie crumble really cemented it’s place in my heart. 10/10 Was thinking about a second bowl before I finished the first haha!

author: Azsedo
title: Dirt
text: I’m eating it right now and it tastes pretty much like a chocolate, dirt, and grass blend.

author: molly_yum
title: My New Favorite!!
text: I bought this flavor on a whim, since my grocery store only had this flavor and another I don't like when I went. OMG, it is my new favorite. So unique and delicious. I just wish there were more yummy truffles!!! I will be buying this regularly now. YUM!!!!!

author: sam347
title: great flavor
text: im so confused i dont think i have a single truffle in mine? i came on here to see if that happened to anyone else and people are saying they are sparse. i've eaten about 1/4th and have not run into a single truffle. good ice cream but that is disappointing

author: Etotheparpar
title: BEST ICE CREAM I'VE EVER HAD
text: I slightly consider myself to be an ice cream enthusiast, and Ben & Jerry's almost always puts out great products. BUT CHOCOLATE SHAKE IT IS ON ANOTHER LEVEL! It is so amazing, especially the truffles. Waiting for it to be restocked at my local Safeway!!!

author: LaceLu88
title: Marshmallow Cream yes please!
text: I was pleasantly surprised to find this flavor tonight in my grocery store and had to try. I was not disappointed! All flavors with your marshmallow cream are good but this one is AMAZING! And this is from an Phish Food addict! I will be back for more!

author: TaylorK
title: Very disappointing
text: This was totally lacking in flavor. Was expecting more of a malt flavor and all i got was a watered down chocolate. It was just really disappointing for me and did not live up to what the package promised. I didn't even bother finishing the container.

author: LARob
title: Awesome!!!
text: This ice cream is delicious! Tons of marshmellow fluff and chocolate fudge bits and creamy smooth chocolate malt ice cream, what is not to like, my god it is heaven! Anyone disappointed with this...all I can say is you must be a hard person to please!

author: TxGalNFL
title: Malty goodness
text: I love chocolate malts. Summers drinking a chocolate malt with my grandmother under the shade of the pecan tree come to mind. Add in a swirl of marshmallow and some chunks of truffles (not cookies therefore not crunchy) make this a top fav for me.

author: Willow
title: Best ice cream ever
text: Bought it because I'm always looking for a chocolate ice cream with marshmallow and no nuts. This is what I have been searching years for! Went back and bought all they had and now I can't find it anymore so came to his site to try and find it.

author: BSmith
title: Amazing flavor
text: Other than the all too limited edition Chocolate Cherry Garcia, (an even better version of my all time favorite B&J’s flavor), Chocolate Shake It is the best new flavor released in a very long time. Everything about it is absolutely delicious.

author: Alex19
title: Great ice cream flavor, not so great truffles
text: The malt chocolate shake ice cream flavor is amazing, especially with the marshmallow. However, the truffles taste like artificial and fake chocolate. I was really disappointed by the truffle flavor, but the overall ice cream was good.

author: Lindsay222
title: What a great idea!!!
text: This is my most favorite ice cream flavor ever. I would eat it almost every day if the Target stores in my area would stock more of it. It’s so delicious. The malty chocolate with the marshmallow and fudge pieces is the best creation

author: Lil__Eats
title: One of my favorites... ever.
text: This is for the ones who love a mild chocolate flavor. It reminds me of drinking Chocolate Egg Cream. I absolutely love this flavor and could eat it without all the marshmallow and chunks (but they just make it all the more better).

author: misskitty
title: Love at first spoonful!
text: This flavor was automatically bumped into my top three fave Ben & Jerry flavors. The ice cream really tastes like a chocolate malt milk shake! The marshmallow and truffles only amp up the experience. You must try this flavor!

author: Shakes
title: Very impressed
text: My favorite is boom chocolata. Although it's tough to pick a favorite. "Chocolate shake it" is right up there. Amazing flavors, texture, and just the right amount of marshmallow and truffles. Very impressed with this one.

author: madi
title: RUINED ICE CREAM FOR ME
text: The Walmarts in my area stopped carrying this flavor for some reason and now I have to find a replacement, since this one has become my go-to flavor. BUT I cannot eat any other ice cream anymore none live up to this stuff.

author: jessicasayles
title: My all time favorite!
text: For me this is just a perfectly balanced ice cream. It's not too sweet and a great mix of flavors. I love it so much I came to write this review. I'm pregnant with my second child now and I crave this flavor all the same!

author: NurseDominique
title: OMG Tastbud Heaven!!!
text: This is ther best flavor & icecream I have EVER had! EVER! I loved everything about this mixture. I need this in a gallon. Marshmallows, chocolate truffles & more yummy stuff. It has a slight chocolate malt taste too.

author: vonster
title: New fav!
text: Please make this more available! Found it once in our little corner store, but now that’s out and I haven’t seen it in Ralph’s nor Vons. Usually I don’t like chocolate ice cream, but this malt version is perfect!

author: Turtle702
title: Very nice!!
text: I am not even a huge chocolate fan but I saw the malted milkshake part and I wasn’t sold.. very nice flavor.. the truffles are soft and tasty and you can taste the milkshake! I would definitely purchase again!

author: ahh72145
title: Truffles need work
text: I bought 2 since it sounds delicious, and it is...except the truffles which are unfortunately terrible. But the malt chocolate ice cream and marshmallow is awesome so you can just eat around the icky bits :)

author: Sweets B
title: My Fav Ice Cream EVER BY FAR!!
text: I would buy out the stock at any store I could find it in because I loved this flavor so much! It even replaced my Half Baked addiction. Now I can barely find it and I am so sad. Please bring it back!!

author: MBrez
title: Good, but the Truffles version was GREAT
text: This is good, especially the malt milk chocolate and marshmallow swirls. But it was soooo much better with the chocolate truffles instead of sea salt caramel. Please go back to the non-caramel version!

author: Rachelcan719
title: Classic Malt Flavor
text: This ice cream changed my life and I can NEVER find it anymore. It tastes just like a classic malt when Dairy Queen and Sonic just don’t get it right. The marshmallow swirl makes it phenomenal as well.

author: Meeegsies
title: Soooo delicious!
text: Admittedly, I'm not usually a fan of chocolate ice cream, but this was milky enough, and I loved it. My kids loved it too, and ever since we had our first pint, we've been trying to get another one.

author: Maddy V
title: Amazing!
text: Bought this on sale because it looked yummy, and it's absolutely amazing! I don't buy a lot of ice cream, but I would definitively get this in the future and keep an eye out if I go to a B&J store.

author: Marky Mark
title: The best chocolate ice cream ever

It really is the best chocolate ice cream I have ever had. They could have aptly named this one Brownie Batter because it really tastes like frozen a brownie. This is for all of us chocoholics out there. Thank you, Ben and Jerry's and please never discontinue this flavor! You have shown the rest that you are the best when you created this flavor.

author: FuzzyGut
title: So insanely good it’s stupid

author: Nicki237

The icecream also is more of a dark chocolate flavor, slightly bitter. Would've tasted much better if it was chocolate fudge icecream or Milk chocolate icecream but still a good icecream I just wouldn't buy it again

author: SFMT

author: LainiPaige

author: Nessyrae23
title: I love Ben and jerrys chocolate

author: WMKonz924

author: Greggo

author: Phish Food Fan

The pudding and cookie swirls: totally out of this world chocolate flavor. My phish food and chocolate fudge brownie have competition! If you love chocolate, buy this pint. It won’t disappoint! Sorry for all the exclamation points but I’m serious, you need to be eating this.

author: nomadicsoul
title: Dark chocolate lover's dream
text: Finally, a chocolate ice cream that is decadent, dark, and not too sweet. The pudding ice cream is an excellent touch and I love that the ice cream is not too milky. The chocolate cookies are a nice touch, although unnecessary to my enjoyment of the experience of eating this wonderful ice cream! Thank you for making a flavor for those of us who believe the only "real" and "tasty" kind of chocolate is dark chocolate!!

author: RottenHead
title: Jesus Has Returned
text:
The level of chocolate this product will bring you is mind and body saturating.
If you need love and you are lonely or female and suffering 'that time' just put yourself in the bliss of this ice cream. The pudding ice cream is spiritual. You might need to eat this ice cream away from others, where they cannot see how it makes you feel. You may not be ready for how it makes you feel.

author: Andrea R
title: BEST CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM
text:
I bought this on a whim because I was craving Chocolate Ice Cream. It's now been 1 1/2 months and my husband and I have eaten no other ice cream except Chocolate Therapy. We hope they never stop making this flavor.
Smooth, rich without being overwhelming, great pudding texture and flavor and wonderful little fudge pieces.
It doesn't get any better.
Also, it's the absolute perfect pint of ice cream for when you have your period, or you're just grumpy and watching movies.

author: famous22
title: The Ultimate Chocolate Ice Cream!
text: So rich in chocolate and has texture throughout the entire pint with loaded chocolate cookies! I get at least a pint every week! Short and simple ingredient list and pretty great nutritionally for all that you get. Thanks Ben & Jerry's!!

author: Sweet tooth
title: Angela
text: My hubby brought this home for me from Albertson's. I probably wouldn't have picked this flavor myself. I usually go for chocolate with lots of stuff in it, nuts, caramel, whatever! It looks simple but the flavor is bold. It tastes like real chocolate, rich and flavorful. Better than any other chocolate ice cream I've had! My teenage daughter agreed, it is delicious!

author: jul_910
title: Better and cheaper than actual therapy!
text: I eat this every night. I calculate calories throughout my day to allow for my Chocolate Therapy.... every. single. night. They laugh at me when I check out at the grocery store - I buy all they have in stock. The intensely dark chocolate, coupled with the cookies and pudding are the perfect way to end the day...every. single. day.

author: ChocolateComa
title: The Best Chocolate Ice Cream I've Had...So Far!
text: When I saw the name I instantly grabbed it because I was in need of some chocolate therapy. I couldn't have been more satisfied and have purchased 3 pints of the stuff over the past few weeks. This will indulge all of your deepest chocolate cravings and leave you a bit depressed when you know there's none left in the freezer. it has all the right notes of milk chocolate and dark chocolate and then there's texture of smooth and creamy, pieces of chocolate cookie and/or brownie, and the silky texture of frozen pudding. This is a winner and I hope they never discontinue it.

author: Lorilt37

Me: "Chocolate therapy ice cream... my favorite."
Son: "Can I try it?"
Me: "Sure, but save me some."
Later, my son walks into the kitchen with a spoon and the empty pint in his hand. "Sorry, Mom. It was just too good to stop."
And it is.
