author: jnewbio
title: Best flavor, but hard to find!
text: This has long been my favorite Ben and Jerry's flavor - the chocolate ice cream in it is deep, dark and delicious, the graham crumb swirl adds just the right bit of texture, the "toasted marshmallow" is more complex than the straight-up marshmallow in Phish Food, and the chunks of chocolate are of the highest quality. Sadly it is hard to find in my area - I look for it in any store I go into and when I find it, buy as many cartons as can fit in my freezer! I tried the new Limited Edition "Gimme S'More" flavor and found it very disappointing. I certainly hope Ben and Jerry's isn't planning to replace the classic S'mores with this new flavor - I'd be heartbroken!

author: Elizcady
title: All Time Favorite Flavor
text: I could eat ice cream everyday and am a bit of a chocoholic, so naturally this is my go to flavor for Ben and Jerry's. Although there are several other chocolate based flavors, its hard to compare and I went through serious withdraw when I couldn't buy it when living in the U.K. While this used to be easy to find in my local grocery stores, I've recently seen it replaced with the new Gimme S'more flavor on the shelves. I am hoping that it isn't going to be discontinued, as the new flavor is completely different. Never one to write reviews, but I feel so passionately that I wanted it to be stated that some of us out there love this one, despite the lower rating.

author: Cait5
title: All-time favorite, but so hard to find!
text: This is my all-time FAVORITE ice cream flavor--period. Ben & Jerry's is terrific, but they have far outdone themselves with S'mores. Nothing else compares. It's been my favorite ice cream since I was a kid, and nothing has ever come close to replacing it. Unfortunately, it also happens to be the MOST DIFFICULT flavor to find. There are no retailers near me that still carry it--it seems to have been phased out, and I hope not in favor of "Gimme S'more," which can't hold a candle to the original S'mores. The rich chocolate flavor, punctuated by fudgy chocolate chunks; paired with velvety toasted marshmallow and delightfully crunchy, textured graham cracker swirls--nothing compares!

author: Matthart82
title: My favorite of all time
text: This is by far my favorite ice cream ever. I don't know what it is, but I am totally addicted to it and will pretty much eat the entire pint in one sitting, even though I don't like eating ice cream that much. I've driven long distances to buy this and was on the website right now just to find out where I can buy this since I just moved to a new state. I was shocked to see that this has some negative reviews and I felt that I should pay the ice cream back by writing this review. But anyway, best ice cream ever.

author: Livy
title: In serious need of an overhaul
text:
The main problem with this flavor is that it has a very poor balance between the three components of a s'more: graham cracker, chocolate and marshmallow. In its current iteration, the chocolate ice cream base completely overpowers everything else to the point where you're left with what tastes like plain chocolate ice cream.
I would suggest completely reinventing this flavor with a graham cracker flavored ice cream base, with chocolate chunks and a much more generous amount of marshmallow swirl.
I think this flavor has the potential to be a fantastic, stand-out flavor, but as it stands I will not be buying it again.

author: Phish Food Fan
title: The Melter
text: I love Ben and Jerry’s. There are a few flavors in particular that I call Melters. This is because I melt into euphoria at the first bite. There are a few that are so good that with the first spoonful I am in heaven. This S’mores ice cream is perfect in my opinion. The chocolate base (B&J does chocolate better than anyone) is dense, rich, sweet, and decedent. The graham and toasted marshmallow play perfectly together and create layers that come apart while spooning, and with the fudge chunks, and this effect makes the pint ridiculously delicious! Just FYI, the other melters are Chocolate Fudge Brownie, Phish Food, Chocolate Therapy, Half Baked, Gimme Smore, Tonight Dough, Peanut Butter World and Chubby Hubby.

author: SarahSS
title: Favorite!
text: S'mores is by far my favorite B&J's flavor. I was upset to see the other reviews saying they were so disappointed! Maybe it was something in a recent batch or whatever, but anytime I get it, it's always perfect! The graham cracker swirls are the best part. So delicious!

author: DeeDee_BakedZiti
title: The best of the best
text: I'm in love with S'mores. In fact, I fell in love with my husband over a pint of S'mores. As teenagers, we shared spoonfuls of the richest chocolate, creamiest marshmallows and bites of graham cracker perfection. 15 years later, we still go "gaga" when we spot it in a store. My only wish is that we could find it more often--it's certainly hard to come by in the tristate area.

author: l0lu47smores
title: My Very favorite and that's saying something
text: Ever since I was a baby I have loved this flavor. When we did a vote in our family about who was the messiest ice cream eater I was voted number one but especially with this flavor. I find this flavor my very favorite and I think that no other flavor is even close in the good range. You're in heaven when you eat it. It has the perfect amount of every flavor. I love it! Definitely a must in your freezer!

author: SugaHG
title: For Chocolate Lovers Only...Unfortunately
text: This flavor was a disappointment. The chocolate ice cream with chocolate chunks over powers the marshmallow swirl and the graham cracker has yet to be tasted. This flavor needs a revision. In the summer when you bite into a s'more you are instantly hit with the graham cracker taste that is followed by the marshmallow and then warm chocolate. This ice cream should be the same. Graham cracker flavored ice cream with an ample amount of marshmallow swirl followed by chocolate chunks and graham cracker bits would do this flavor justice. As it is now, I will never buy again, I won't even finish this pint!

author: Michele
title: If anything happens to this flavor I will die...
text: There aren’t enough stores that carry this flavor! There aren’t nearly enough chocolate based b&j flavors but this one is perfect! The roasted marshmallow is so good & the graham is delicious. The only thing I might recommend would be to add more graham ... and to get more stores to carry it!

author: mooksT
title: Awesome flavor! Impossible to find.
text: This is my wife's all time favorite flavor of B&J (going back to when it was called Marsha Marsha Marshmallow), but we cannot find it anywhere near us even though the Flavor Finder says 2 different chains in our area carry it. I've been to all of those stores in ~10 mile radius and they don't even have a slot for it on the shelf. B&J's online store doesn't even carry it. I would be willing to pay a hefty premium to have it delivered at this point. I did see it recently at a Safeway in California when I was there on business, but was not in a position to try and haul it home with me on a plane. WE WANT THE S'MORES!

author: JenR
title: FAVORITE
text: My absolute favorite flavor of Ben & Jerry's! The chocolate ice cream as always is delicious. S'mores ice cream should always have a chocolate base. I love the texture of the chunks of chocolate and graham crackers. I'm glad they chose to go with a whipped marshmallow rather than fluffy marshmallow chunks. This flavor really can't be beat!

author: Smores4lyfe
title: The literal best flavor
text: It's not like I can find it anywhere anymore but, it's still my favorite. Hopefully B&J will get with the program and have it more widely available in NYC again!

author: Sarah4
title: Plain chocolate ice cream
text: Cannot even taste the graham cracker or marshmallow. I taste more marshmallow in the Phish Food. Chocolate should not be the base of this ice cream it completely overpowers anything else that could be there. I'd recommend a graham cracker ice cream with ample swirls of marshmallow and fudge as a remake of this flavor

author: Zoid
title: I officially have a new favorite flavor...
text: Phish Food used to be my favorite, until I first had S'mores. Now I can't get enough of it. For some reason it only appears to be sold in Publix in my area, so I have to make the extra trek to Publix just to get me some S'mores. The problem is they sell out of it frequently so I have to check back often. Very well balanced and frankly addictive. Please expand the retail distribution so all the s'mores fans in my area don't have to fight for the limited inventory at Publix. THANKS!

author: Doug
title: Love it
text: I look for the S'mores every time I hit the grocer. Now to find the ever elusive S'mores Ice Cream bar!

author: TheFoodie21
title: Delicious flavor that keeps me coming back!
text: This particular flavor has to be one of my favorites I absolutely love the marshmallow swirl and the graham cracker pieces.The chocolate chunks were good too though I wish the pieces were a little bit smaller, still, won't stop me from getting this ice cream.

author: Christy
title: Best flavor on earth!
text: This is my addiction! I love it's more a semi sweet chocolate with the marshmallow and graham cracker... I have no idea what I will do if they ever stop making this ice cream. I call dibs on the recipe if you ever discontinue!

author: trashpanda1971
title: Legit the BEST
text: I die of sadness every time I’m in the mood for B&J, but the store doesn’t carry this flavor...it has ALL THE THINGS...delish chocolate ice cream, graham cracker crack bits, and sweet, sweet toasted marshmallow swirls. One of the few foods in life that is worth the calories...when I see people give this flavor a low score I literally want to fist fight them.

author: RS30
title: Best ice cream ever!!!
text: So this was my favorite ice cream ever!!! all the flavors match so well and the combination of the chocolate ice cream with the graham cracker is great. If I could ask for anything would be to have a little more graham cracker in it, but is still absolutely delicious. However I'm deeply sad to see that this flavor is no longer available... just so disappointing and now I'm struggling to find another ice cream to substitute my favorite ever S'mores! :(

author: kpwr
title: best ice cream in america
text: head and shoulders the best of the bunch. why so hard to find?

author: Nowan
title: Chocolate AGAIN?
text: I tried this a week ago then just now put it up against Phish Food. Here's the deal, imagine your a the S'mores flavored ice cream for a moment...then you looks at yourself and essentially you realize you've been created as a competition to Rocky Road ice creams and your own sibling Phish Food. Someone else offered an amazing idea of making this a graham cracker ice cream GAME CHANGER!, lets take it onestep further,..Making it a CORE then my freinds you've done it, A S'mores in a pint, the outside consists of a Graham Cracker Ice Cream and a Marshmallow & Fudge core. idk food for thought.

author: allisonlovesicecream94
title: My favorite flavor! But so hard to find :(
text: When I was living in NYC, I found this flavor one time in my local bodega. Ever since then, it's been my favorite Ben & Jerry's flavor. I recently moved back to Michigan and cannot find it anywhere! The graham cracker swirls balance out the decadent chocolate flavors and the toasted marshmallow adds this gooey element that is perfectly complex and sweet. Luckily, when I visit my boyfriend who is stationed in North Dakota, his store carries it and I'm able to get my fix. I hope this flavor never gets discontinued!

author: FuzzyGut
title: Really good stuff.
text: I just melt when I dig into certain B&J flavors and this is one of them. Everything about S’mores is great, I just wish the marshmallow and graham swirls were thicker. This is a great pint and I will definitely be buying it again.

author: Stacey
title: Best Flavor Ever!!!!
text: My husband and I drive all the way across town to buy this ice cream at least twice a week! It is the BEST! I love that is is very chocolatey with a hint of marshmallow and graham cracker. It's perfection!

author: bluethreads
title: lacks s'mores flavor
text: I was excited to see a few brands of ice cream offering s'mores flavor at my supermarket! S'mores is one of my favorites! I thought the flavor might be difficult to capture in an ice cream and decided my best bet was to go for Ben and Jerry's. It seems I made the wrong choice, as their ice cream tasted like chocolate chocolate chip. There were a few graham cracker swirls, but I couldn't detect any marshmallows. I don't know if the marshmallows were supposed to be flavored within the graham cracker swirl, but the taste never came together as anything but chocolate. The ice cream was a super delicious chocolate chocolate chip ice cream, but if you are expecting an ice cream resembling s'mores, I'd try another brand.

author: bmhansen513
title: S'mores Lover's Dream
text: If you are like me and enjoy S'mores, you will not be disappointed with this pint. I have read some of the bad reviews and I think people have come across some imbalanced pints, but that it no way should take away from what this flavor is at its best. I have had imbalanced pints in every flavor and chalk it up to nuances in the manufacturing process. This one may be slightly more prone to imbalances, but the flavor is so good that I am more than willing to put up with a few "misses" from time to time.

author: nickmemyself
title: SAVE THIS FLAVOR
text: PLEASE, this is my favorite flavor and if it went away I don't know what I would do, the graham cracker chunks are heaven and everything about this spells happiness.

author: Rhirhi
title: Best flavor!!
text: I love this ice cream. I wish they sold it in a bigger size. I would literally buy gallons of this stuff. Best flavor ever!

author: Lolly
title: Best Chocolate Ice Cream
text: I love chocolate ice creams and this is my favorite of them all..

author: Tracy1975
title: Better flavor than the new S'mores
text: I accidentally bought the "new" s'mores flavor thinking it was this one. This one has much better flavor. It tastes like Smores because it has marshmallow and Graham cracker and chocolate. The new one tastes like vanilla ice cream with Oreo cookie pieces. Nothing Smores about it.

author: BriBri
title: My Favorite!
text: This is one of my favorite flavors. So chocolaty! I love the marshmallow and graham cracker flavor too!

author: BC1226
title: Camp In A Pint
text: Love the toasted flavor in the marshmallow and overall is one of my favorite flavors!

author: jdodge23
title: Amazing
text: First time trying s'mores ice cream and I love it!

author: maya3
title: What s'mores?
text: I was craving s'mores on a hot day, which naturally led me to the perfect idea: s'mores ice cream! I was so excited to try this flavor that I bought two tubs of it at the store, only to be sorely disappointed. This doesn't even taste like s'mores, it's basically just chocolate ice cream. The chocolate ice cream base overpowers all the other flavors... such a disappointment.

author: Sarah
title: Disappointed
text: I'm a long time Ben and jerries fan, and I've never been let down by any of the flavors, until this one. In the entire pint I only got one bite of marshmallow, which is not what I expected from and ice cream named smores. It would have been an excellent flavor if it had more marshmallow and graham crackers in it.

author: pollosmoky
title: My Favorite
text: My favorite, but suddenly I can't find it! I am overcome with grief at this development. Other chocolate/marshmallow-y ice creams suffice, but it's the slightly salty graham-y flavor that really makes S'mores fabulous. Phish Food is much too sweet, and all those dang fish are in the way. Please tell me you're not retiring this flavor. If you must retire it, I demand Glampfire Trail Mix be put in regular rotation, bc if I can't have a graham cracker swirl, then a pretzel swirl will have to do.

author: j12345
title: Favorite flavor ever!!
text: I don't understand all the bad reviews for this flavor. It is my all time favorite, and I think it's perfect. The marshmallow and graham swirls give it a nice soft texture, with the chocolate chips giving it just a bit of crunch. It is a little heavy on the chocolate flavor, but then again, so are real s'mores. Graham and marshmallow are subtle to begin with and come through great here. I haven't tried the newer flavor that has graham ice cream, but don't know how it could improve on this!

author: Debra
title: LOVE the strong chocolate flavor and mix ins
text: Oh my goodness this is my favorite ice cream ever. The chocolate ice cream base tastes dark, which is so rare and hard to find. I absolutely love it and can't get enough. Thank you! I hope you never change the recipe.

author: foodie29
title: Amazing Flavor!
text:
This ice cream combines everything I love about smores. The chocolate ice cream is a perfect choice for the base--creamy, rich, delicious. Ben and Jerry's has managed to create an amazing gooey marshmallow with a real toasted marshmallow flavor. I go crazy over that marshmallow swirl. I'm also crazy for the graham cracker bits--they add some amazing texture to the ice cream that I love, and have great flavor. Then, to top it all off, the crunchy chocolate bits. This is a great ice cream if you like texture in your ice cream, and I do. This is fun to eat, and totally delicious. This is an ice cream you have to stop after the first bite (and the 20th!) to say "Wow, that's good."
Side note--I tried "Gimmie Smores" and found it frankly dull. It tasted like generic cookies and cream ice cream. It wasn't rich and decadent and exciting like this. S'mores is a far superior ice cream. Also, the Campfire ice cream hits some similar notes but still isn't as good. I don't like nuts, and I appreciate having some amazing ice creams that don't rely on those for interest. This is the real winner.

author: NSEGS
title: Best flavor ever!!
text: This is the best combination of flavors! We love this ice cream so much and it is impossible to find. Really hoping it is not replaced with the new Gimme S’mores flavor which is not great.

author: Tyra
title: One Word. Amazing!
text: I took one spoonful of this and fell in love. I could not stop eating until I reached the bottom. Hope this never goes away. Did not have any marshmallows, but I was too in love to care.

author: Lexx
title: Very disappointing :(
text: I LOVE Ben and Jerrys ice cream. I LOVE anything s'mores flavored so I thought this would be my new favorite B&J flavor but unfortunately I was disappointed. It really did not taste like s'mores at all and tasted pretty much like plain chocolate ice cream. I was really rooting for this one because I love s'mores but this did nothing for me :( it would be the perfect ice cream if it tasted like actual s'mores!

author: Mickfrogger
title: Very disappointed
text: What makes me sad is ben and jerrys has the ability to make this a great ice cream, but they didn't. It tastes like chocolate chocolate chip ice cream. I actually thought I got a dud pint because i couldnt taste any graham. If they did a separate thick graham cracker swirl a la their pumpkin cheesecake ice cream and a thicker toasted marshmallow swirl it could be what it claims to be. Won't buy this flavor again.

author: Eric15
title: Best Flavor!
text: This is the best flavor in my opinion but it not stocked very well in the KY area. Makes it very hard to find!!! Please fix guy!

author: tyler321321321
title: My Favorite Flavor
text:
Ben and Jerry's Smores is my favorite flavor of not just b&j but ALL ice cream in general. It's AMAZING! Smores ice cream should always have chocolate as a base and the toasted marshmallow creme tastes JUST like real toasted marshmallow.
I found this flavor a few months ago and haven't had another flavor of ice cream since. I am super sad I can't seem to find this one anymore since it seems to have been replaced with the "more s'mores" flavor (which is infinitely worse)

author: Smoresgirl31
title: I love it but I’m so disappointed!!
text: This is my FAVORITE flavor Ben & Jerry’s offers. It’s my go to ice cream in the supermarket. The only problem is that it’s so inconsistent! Lately I’ve only gotten mostly chocolate ice cream, barely any marshmallow inside the pints (which is my favorite part). Last batch I had didn’t have any graham cracker or marshmallow. I don’t want to give up on this product but I just wish they could get it right! Will not be buying for a while, maybe the wait will be worth it..

author: MusicPhan
title: Yummy! Yummy! Yummy!
text: My favorite flavor! Lately I haven’t been able to find it anywhere. I want s’more!!!

author: janderson
title: S’mores
text: Amazing, miss this flavor so much. All things s’mores from B&J I miss desperately

author: zackbrown322
title: Tastes Nothing Like S'mores
text: I honestly don't know what Ben and Jerry's was thinking with this concoction. The balance between the traditional s'mores flavors (graham cracker, chocolate, and marshmallow) in this pint is completely off. It ends up tasting like plain chocolate ice cream. Now Ben & Jerry's has come out with an additional s'mores flavor. But why? Just revamp this one! Probably the most disappointing pint of ice cream I've ever bought.

author: Em77
title: Love it!
text: I love this ice cream SO much! By far my favorite!

author: Tali
title: Not their best...
text: I'm a die-hard B&J's fan, but they really got it wrong with this one. When I got it I first thought something was wrong because it only tasted like chocolate ice cream with nothing else -- but then I saw the rest of the reviews here and I guess it's just the flavor! I was really excited for the graham crackers but I they're practically non existent. I'm pretty disappointed, hopefully the rest of the flavors don't lose their character like this o

author: Jlcchavez
title: Is this s'mores?
text:
First off, I love Ben and Jerrys.
I always love trying all your different flavors and was pretty excited to try this! But I could not taste anything but chocolate, good chocolate ice cream nonetheless. I would consider tweaking this recipe I could visibly see all the marshmallow swirl which seemed abundant but the chocolate ice cream base is to strong to even taste the other flavors.

author: goldcrab
title: Something feels wrong
text: Usually this is my favorite flavor, have been treating myself every few months to S'mores for years. The one I bought today though, I almost thought it was a different product. Could barely see any marshmallow, the chocolate was overpowering, and I got a feeling I was eating condensed milk or something at times instead of anything s'mores related. I hope this was just a bad batch and not a permanent change :\

author: Bren2424
title: the *BEST* ice cream flavor ever
text:
This is the only ice cream I'll eat. It's literally my favorite. I would eat it all the time if it were easier to find in stores! They stocked it where I used to live and ever since I moved I haven't been able to find It which makes me so sad. Ben and Jerrys, distribute it more! it's heaven in a pint and I miss it SO MUCH.
(p.s. "Gimme S'mores is NOT as good AT ALL. Pales in comparison.

author: ejav
title: Good chocolate ice cream, but not much else
text: I was really excited to get this for my wife since she loves chocolate and marshmallow and I thought this would be a match made in heaven with B&J being her favorite ice cream brand, but lo and behold this was probably the most underwhelming flavor to date. Tasted like a decent chocolate ice cream but other than that it was generic and didn’t have much of a s’mores taste to it.

author: Mnoa
title: Literally soooo disappointed with this flavor.
text:
I just bought this thinking I’d love it and it could not be the furthest thing from s’mores. It’s pure chocolate ice cream; very strong and dark chocolate to say the least. Cannot even even see, let alone taste, the marshmallow or the graham cracker.
Did not like this one bit. Chocolate was a bad idea for this ice cream. The picture and description are very deceiving. P

author: Amy77
title: Best Ice Cream Ever!!!!!!!
text: Omg! This is the BEST ice cream you’ll ever have. It’s hard do find. They don’t even have it at their own ice cream shop. Gimme s’more is nothing like it - I wouldn’t even buy that. “S’mores” is the best! I hope they keep making it. It’s smooth and not too sweet. The chocolate flavor is awesome combined with graham crackers and marshmallows!! I LOVE this ice cream!!!

author: ColoradoKate
title: More S'mores I Implore
text: Been buying this chocolaty delight since my daughter was a toddler.....and she's now a licensed driver. This decadent flavor is my before-bed ritual. Smooth rich deep chocolate flavor with delicious fudge chunks and swirls of lip-smacking goodness. None of your other flavors compare to this delight. S'mores will always have a place in my heart.....and freezer.

author: Shaina
title: A bit sad
text: I have been a Ben and Jerry’s lover since childhood. With that being said it is rare that I come across a flavor that I am not a fan of. Being that I love Ben and Jerry’s as well as s’mores, I was really excited to try this. The base flavor was fine but I was not reminded of s’mores while eating this. I actually didn’t even finish the pint, which never happens.

author: Voltages230
title: Not the flavor you're expecting
text: I would expect a S'mores flavored ice cream to taste like my favorite dessert ever, a S'more. What I ended up getting was an overpowered chocolate flavor with tiny hints of graham cracker and even more chocolate in the form of the fudge chunks. I'm pretty disappointed in this flavor as usually I love B&J ice cream. Definitely won't be purchasing this again.

author: jennk83
title: Best flavor
text: This is my all-time favorite Ben & Jerry’s flavor. They changed it up a bit sometime in the last couple of years, but it’s still very delicious. It has become increasingly difficult to find since the introduction of “Gimme S’more” (which I do not enjoy half as much), so when I do manage to find it, I stock up. Perfect flavor combination, not to be missed.

author: Vonnie
title: Not What I Was Expecting
text: I am a S'mores fanatic, so once I saw this in the grocery store, I went crazy! Lol I was expecting a marshmallow based ice cream with a fudge swirl and Graham cracker and fudge chunks. Unfortunately, I found myself eating chocolate flavored ice cream. The Smores flavor was overpowered by the chocolate smh I tried, but it was nothing that I was expecting.

author: vtmmm
title: Taste of Summer with Lots of Chocolate
text: My current favorite flavor! I love the creamy marshmallow swirls and the sandy texture of graham cracker crumbs, plus chocolate chunks. Some people feel it's not "balanced" enough, but as a chocolate person I'm perfectly happy to have my s'mores be more chocolate than anything! It's as if you took your s'more and crumbled it in chocolate ice cream!

author: sublimecls
title: Amazing flavor, my fav!!
text: This flavor is just PERFECTION for me! The dark chocolatey ice cream base is stellar, the gritty swirls of almost wet sand textured graham cracker is SO GOOD and the touches of toasted marshmalllow swirled throughout just top it off perfectly. I will never survive if they get rid of this flavor. I hat when I can’t find it in stock!

author: JakeJr9
title: SPECTACULAR SMORES
text: Hey stores in Delaware - if you want my grocery business you had better start stocking this flavor. My favorite used to be chocolate and peanut butter ice cream. But once I tried Smores I find myself driving around until I find a store that carries it. Do yourself a favor - if you have not tried this flavor - do so now.

author: Penelopetm
title: Most addictive flavor of all!
text:
I absolutely love everything about this flavor. The chocolate base is the best. B&J has very few flavors with chocolate base and no nuts.
My only problem is that NONE of the stores around me carry it anymore. They all carry the new S'mores flavor - which isn't chocolate ice cream. Sad ice cream-less summer for me.

author: Bryant
title: Best I have ever had!!!
text: My wife and I treat ourselves to Ben and Jerry’s on Friday nights. We used to buy S’mores and share it every Friday for 8 years!!! We can’t find it anywhere in North Carolina anymore. None of the other flavors are even close to comparing. Very sad that we can’t get it. It’s not even available in the online store.

author: Gustine
title: Disappointed
text: I was excited to see my store finally selling the s’mores flavor so I obviously bought it. I started eating it today and it’s just chocolate ice cream with a little bit of graham cracker and almost no marshmallow. I won’t be buying this again but I will recommend my favorites: Cherry Garcia and The Tonight Dough

author: Nicky91
title: Disappointing
text: I feel like they really dropped the ball with this flavor. The marshmallow and Graham crackers are entirely overpowered by the chocolate ice cream and chunks of fudge. I had really high hopes for this one. I think it would be so much better with a Graham flavored ice cream or even a marshmallow one.

author: momo9324
title: Poor S'more Flavor
text: I had high expectations for this ice cream as I love anything s'more flavor, but this ice cream just didn't cut it. It literally just tasted like chocolate ice cream. No graham cracker or marshmallow flavor at all. Sorry Ben & Jerry's, love your ice cream, but this flavor could use some work

author: Lauren14
title: I LOVE S'MORES
text: This flavor is my favorite because of the graham cracker swirls; they are to die for. This is always my ice cream go to and I am so sad that s'mores isn't sold at most ben&jerrys retailers. I have such a hard time finding it these days that I usually am forced to settle for other flavors.

author: Vali
title: Too much chocolate
text: Insanely chocolatey. Needs more marshmallow and graham crackers because all I could taste was chocolate.

author: Adrienne
title: Lack of S'mores
text: Not your typical summer treat flavor...the chocolate ice cream is overpowering and the taste of graham cracker and marshmallow bits is non-existent. Very disappointed by our choice of ice cream. Ben & Jerry's is known for exceptional and creative flavors, but this one misses the mark.

author: Mbrown80
title: Yuck
text: Tastes nothing like s'mores. Such dark chocolate ice cream...i don't understand why it has fudge, as s'mores do not...the marshmallow is not enough to help the overpowering darkness of the ice cream, and the graham doesn't taste at all, just contributes a sandy texture. Hard pass.

author: morganutley
title: Favorite Flavor!
text: The Dutch chocolate base is DELICIOUS, and the occasional bites of crumbled graham cracker, marshmallow, and chocolate just make it that much better. Purists may prefer more "S'mores" flavor, as the chocolate ice cream is really bold, but I think it's beyond excellent as is.

author: Stine70
title: Love, love, love this flavor
text: I am always on the hunt for this flavor when we visit a grocery store. I can’t get enough of the rich chocolate, buttery graham cracker, marshmallow swirl and chocolate pieces. I try so hard to ration it out, but I’m usually done in 4-5 nights. Thx for the yummy creation!

author: Brandy35
title: Ehhh
text: I was excited to try the smores....but the chocolate overpowered everything.

author: av3rros
title: Drowning in Chocolate
text: This is one of Ben & Jerry's most disappointing flavors. It tastes like nothing but chocolate ice cream. I didn't taste a single fudge chunk or roasted marshmallow it it. and that graham cracker swirl was non-existent. I'm shocked this hasn't made it to the graveyard yet.

author: tiredfrom work
title: Isn't all that much different from Phish Food
text: As a chocolate ice cream, it's OK, but if you're going to call an ice cream smores, it should at least taste like smores. This is nothing but chocolate. I barely see any marshmallow,and I don't know where the graham crackers are supposed to be. Pretty disappointing.

author: SmoresLover
title: BEST FLAVOR EVER
text: S'mores has been my favorite flavor for YEARS. I love the chocolate base and the surprise of the marshmallow and graham cracker swirls within. Lately I haven't been able to find it in stores very often. Please don't send to the flavor graveyard. I would seriously cry.

author: Krystle
title: Only chocolate
text: I just opened my pint, when I took off the lid, I saw marshmallow, I was excited. But after I got threw that small layer of marshmallow, I couldn't find anymore. I didn't see or taste any Graham cracker. And I only saw a few chocolate chips. I think I got a mistake!

author: TammyC
title: Not worth the cost
text: I bought this yesterday and I went to 4 differrrnt stores until I found it! I was so happy then when I tasted it I didn't see any marshmallow until I reached the middle and it was too much chocolate I spent over 8 bucks because I got two and I was very disappointed.

author: johanna
title: favorite
text: this is my fave b&j flavor!!! however i have been seeing less and less of this flavor in stores. i hope they are trying to replace it with that horrid “gimme s’more” flavor...that flavor could never compare to this classic. please keep this flavor ben and jerry’s!!

author: Nickolaix
title: Favorite Flavor
text: I read other reviews that claimed that the chocolate overpowers the other components, but I think that is what I like. Chocolate ice cream is my jam, and S'mores brings chocolate ice cream to a new level with the addition of some marshmallow and graham cracker.

author: JennP
title: This is so chocolately...Best flavor
text: This is my FAVORITE B&J ice cream. The chocolate ice cream is so rich. The crunchy graham cracker part is yummy too. This ice cream is so hard to find in the stores so if you do find it, stock up like I do. I'm so sad that I don't have any right now.

author: Catie
title: Poor mixture
text: I bought this flavor to try because of the amazing reviews. However, I was really disappointed. There was maybe one or two graham cracker chunks and that was it. The ratios were very off. However, if you like chocolate ice cream, this is the pint for you

title: Favorite Flavor, ATM.
text: I agree with a lot of reviewers that this is mostly chocolate...and could use more marshmallow...but it's still awesome. I love the flavor and texture of the graham cracker swirl. I allways get excited when I see this at my store and never pass it up.

author: Mhoss
title: Best Flavor Ever!
text: This is by far my favorite Ben & Jerry’s flavor! The chocolate ice cream with the graham cracker crumbs and toasted marshmallow is the perfect combination and taste just like biting into a s’more! If only it was available at more locations...

author: Epersha
title: Favorite ice cream ever!!!
text: This is what happiness tastes like. I freakin LOVE B&J s’mores! I’m pregnant right now and am so sad that I can’t find it in my local grocery stores because I am seriously craving it!!! I am mystified why Regis isn’t a Moreno popular flavor!

author: invalid username
title: my favorite, perfectly balanced
text: So delicious, but hard to find around these parts. It is perfectly balanced between the chocolatey icecream, the marshmallows and the best of all, the graham swirls which to me seem to have a bit of saltiness... altogether, it's just yum.

There is also swirls of thick chocolate fudge and tiny chuck of chocolate sandwich cookie pieces! The best way to eat this is to let it melt a bit and swirl it all around to mix up the choclate fudge and chocolate sandwich cookie peices. Great Job Ben and Jerry's - and Jimmy Falon! And wow, am I ever grateful for that day, this is my favourite ice cream by far! Great quality and great taste! I definitely recommend this product! Also you can often catch it on sale!

author: ThePurplePerp
title: Unbelievably good
text:
I dunno what more you could want from your ice cream.
I bought chocolate syrup when i bought this flavor cuz I was in the mood for chocolaty awesomeness but I didn't even end up using the syrup because the ice cream disappeared before I remembered it was there. Now I can't stop thinking about buying more. It's addictive. Which is what led me here. Yes. yes. and yes. and yes.

author: BrendaNoraG
title: Literally the best flavor of ice cream Ever
text: Please don’t ever discontinue this flavor, it’s the absolute best. I tell all my friends and family to try Tonight Dough. If you love sweets and chocolate and peanut butter, this is for you. You have to try it and you will instantly be hooked. I can’t explain to you the happiness I get from opening the lid and getting the chocolate cookie crumble on the top layer. Heaven!!!!!

author: badesim
title: THE LOVE OF MY LIFE
text: After the first time I ever tried this ice cream, I was unable to crave any other ice cream. It honestly changed the whole game for me. I love the texture and the flavor combination. I always recommend it to all my friends and wish It was easier to find in grocery stores. Honestly, can you just sponsor me? I promise you won't find anyone more passionate about this than I am.

author: TyTheIceCreamGuy
title: WOW HOLY COW
text: Okay! Ben? Jerry? Whose wacky idea was THIS? I flippin LOVE IT. From the very first bite (wow! I shouldn’t bite ice cream it’s very COLD)

author: abscog
text: This ice cream combines all the best parts of Ben and Jerry's including chocolate, vanilla, cookie dough and brownies. I love everything about this ice cream and there is absolutely NOTHING that I feel needs to be changed about it. I only wish that it wasn't so popular because it is sold out every time I go to the store. (kidding) keep up the excellent work Ben and Jerry.

author: katieg108
text: Ben and Jerrys is known in my family as the best Ice cream around. When a carton of half baked is placed in my freezer I know it will not last more than a week! I absolutely love this flavor! It has a perfect hint of saltiness in the dough and creamy sweetness in the ice cream! This is far superior to half baked because the different doughs in this mixture are much better!

author: ABigBnJFan26
title: Fav Ice Cream
text: This is by far my favorite ice cream. Super creamy, not too rich, loads of delicious big chunks of cookie. I was surprised by the swirls of chocolate cookie. It can be a bit sandy at times but I don't mind the texture so for those adverse to it maybe it's not for you. Thank you for the wonderful ice cream B&J, this is my special go-to treat every time I want a pick me up.

author: BWash007
title: AAA- Ma-Zing
text: How could you not love? perfect blend of all ingredients added! Not too much of anything. I seriously have left all my other favorites behind and purchase EVERYTIME I pass the ice cream aisle and see it in stock. This satisfies every craving. I also love how vanilla is the base and everything else complements. WHO GAVE THIS ICE CREAM 1 or 2 STARS?!?!?!?! HOW!?

author: jessica_n
text: The tonight dough is the SUPERIOR flavor out of all of the Ben and Jerry's flavors. If my family is getting ice cream, the tonight dough is definitely our first option. It is disappointing though because this flavor is always sold out (because it is so good). There is so much going on in one container. You must try it. You (probably) won't regret it :)

author: sourninja
text: This is my favorite ice cream of all time. Legit I get a little irrational when there isnt any left at my local store. I dont care what it costs, if I have a craving this will be put into my mouth as soon as I can possibly get it. The peanut butter chunks are enough to write your grandmother and tell her you found your soulmate. And its an ice cream.

author: ekenzzz
title: the best!

OMG i don't think i'll ever turn back. it makes me upset when i go to grab some and there's every other flavour other than this one! i'm addicted, please please please never get rid of this

author: Lucky
title: No cookie dough :(
text: I bought this yesterday and I was so excited to eat it because I bought it before and loved it, but this time around there was barely any cookie swirl and there was only PB dough chunks, no cookie dough chunks. Very disappointed, might have to start sticking to half baked instead. :( not only that but this time the pb dough had a weird flavour.

author: mdvnielle_
text: i’m a cookie dough type of girl. cookie dough ice cream is definitely my guilty pleasure. i’ve tried every brand of cookie dough ice cream. this one was alright. although it isn’t labeled as cookie dough, it’s still dough in it. i though this this one was little too sweet for me and i would prefer the dough chunks to be a little bit smaller.

author: rainbowbee3
text: Cookie dough ice cream is one of my favorites. I love this variation of it. It has chocolate chip and peanut butter cookie dough. The chocolate mixed in with the caramel and chocolate ice cream just makes this wonderful. I usually eat this in one or 2 sittings. There is no sharing when it comes to Ben & Jerry's The Tonight Dough Ice Cream

Its nice and creamy and the chunks give it an added boost of flavor. I usually try to control myself and tell myself that I will only get a scoop but next thing I know the pint is gone. Its reasonably priced so you can afford to stock up on a few of the favs for later. They keep really well unlike some that tend to get freezer burn easily.

author: shelbyg2189
text: Let me get this off my chest: Jimmy Fallon is my soulmate. He just gets me. So it's only fitting that his face would be plastered on my favourite ice cream as well. This is the best combination of wanting to add all the toppings at the dessert bar but not wanting to go too far and ruining the flavour. It's the perfect balance of flavours

title: One of my favorites
text: This is one of my absolute favorite ice creams! Every time I see it in the store I have to buy it! My boyfriend will even surprise me with a pint of it sometimes because I love it so much. When I was really sick recently (with a sore throat) I pretty much lived off of this stuff because it was the only thing that didn't hurt to eat!

Oh my goodness! So delicious and the perfect treat any time of the day! Some days you just need to come home and binge watch your favorite Netflix rom-coms and eat ice cream! This ice cream will make your insides feel better than any man ever could it tastes like you landed on the moon filled with all kinds of cookie dough goodness

author: bgdl26
title: MY favorite ice cream ever!

Have you changed the consistency of it? It was always soft and melted in your mouth. It's now kind of hard and crumbles. (does that make sense haha)

author: drinkswithnadia
text: Every once in awhile Ill treat myself to a Ben and Jerry's Ice Cream The Tonight Dough - 16oz ! Something about this particular flavor stands above the others in my opinion ! Theres so many textures and flavors coming from the two different cookie doughs! If you like chocolate, peanut butter and cookie dough... this is for you!

author: Ms Kentucky
title: OMG... One Mouthwatering Good
text: While on vacation in Atlantic Beach, We stopped at the Ben & Jerry's store. My eyes were speaking to me... what's this wonderful ice cream flavor. Fresh and in a waffle bowl, PURE delight. Since we have been home. I have been looking for a place where I can get more. Because this was an awesome flavor! Thank you Ben & Jerry's

author: jasonrob79
text: This is a good flavor if you are a fan of cookie dough as it has two different kinds in it and its actually done correctly and taste great. Its not my first choice but I do enjoy it when I dont have my usual brand in stock at my local store. As Ive said if you are a fan of cookie dough this might be your next favorite flavor

author: leslies65a5
text: This is the best combination of vanilla chocolate and cookie doughI love cookie dough. I can sit and eat an entire pint. Youre able to taste and savor each flavor. You can never go wrong with a little tiny pieces of chocolate bits so good. It is a little pricey about 4 to 5 dollars for a pint but definitely worth it.

author: michelleb3082
text: Ben & Jerry's tonight dough is basically one of the only ice creams I will eat, it is to die for. It combineschocolateandcaramelice creams withchocolate chip cookie dough,peanut butter cookie doughand a crunchychocolatecookie swirl. It is so good! if you haven't tried it you definitely need to get some immediately!!

author: yai_martinez17
text: This would definitely be my favorite Ben and Jerry's ice cream. I got it once to try and see if I liked it, since I'm not really an ice cream person, and I fell in love. It's one of the best flavors Ben and Jerry's offers. The two ice cream flavors and the two types of cookie dough just really complement each other.

author: roshh1
text: Let me start by saying WOW!! I had to force myself to stop eating this, or I would have consumed the whole pint. This flavor has now become my favorite! I had been looking for a tasty dairy free ice cream (Im lactose intolerant) but what the heck, Ill just take my pill before enjoying this deliciousness! Buy it!

author: tarlanella
text: This flavor is a party in your mouth. Whoever thought to blend a mixture of so many chocolate favorites is a genius and deserves an award. I am a repeat customer and have purchased this pint of cream 20+ times in my lifetime. I recommend to ALL my friends. I love this flavor so much. Its 100% a guilty pleasure.

author: Mya788
title: Absolutely to die for!!!

I can’t keep my hands from buying it off the shelves which is probably why my New Years resolution isn’t going to great lol. Nonetheless, I hope they never get rid of it.

author: faspee
text: This is the second time I've bought this brand and it was also well worth the money. I will buy this again for sure! It's very good for that girls night out and you need that comfort food. So many yummy chunks cookie dough and peanut butter cookie dough. Satisfaction was achieved after this was consumed.

author: jennyw50
text: I got to try this for my first time recently. I love the variety in there with chocolate, caramel, COOKIE DOUGH!! Anything with cookie dough has my vote. The peanut butter conflicted with the caramel just a bit too much for me, but overall super delicious. Im happy whenever I can find B&J on sale for $4!

author: stephaniem100
text: The perfect alternative to regular cookie dough ice cream! This has your standard chocolate chip cookie dough and peanut butter cookie dough mixed with chocolate and carmel ice cream. I gotta say my favorite part is the cookie crunch swirled in, gives you a nice crunch of texture every once in a while.

author: Icecreamfan4life
title: Interesting Mix
text: Bought this a couple nights ago on a whim. Had seen it plenty of times when I was looking at other flavors to try out, as I'm not typically a real big chocolate ice cream fan do to the bitter taste it can have at times. But I've found that I really enjoy B&J's chocolate ice creams. Very smooth and light flavor. So I finally opted to break down and chose to buy this flavor. And have to say that I wasn't quite unsatisfied with it. I mean the chocolate and caramel ice creams came together beautifully with the chocolate chocolate chip cookie swirl. But I have to admit there was something off with the peanut butter cookie dough. I have no idea, if they taste off, do to possibly being made from a vegan recipe. But, I could very faintly taste the peanut butter as well as some kind of floral-esque note at the end. Was kind of strange tasting. I think maybe if the recipe was adjusted a bit or maybe just adding a peanut butter swirl or core to this pint, would really make everything come together.

author: AJ42
title: BEST FLAVOR!!!! :)
text: I recently went to a Ben & Jerry's store and purchased The Tonight Dough but in a milkshake and although I am lactose intolerant, this was one of the best decisions I made. This ice cream is AMAZING, and I would defiantly be buying it. Hope they make this flavor dairy free one day to help me out.

author: girlwithnoclue
text: Ben & Jerry are my two favorite men because not only are they SMASHING the patriarchy, but theyve been killing the ice cream game for years. This flavor is the most packed with toppings so be aware if you like simple ice creams! A cookie dough lovers dream, the cookie swirl is my favorite!

author: sambutneversammy
text: I never thought I would be a fan of peanut butter cookie dough in an ice cream as I am really picky about where I taste peanut butter. However, they balance the flavors so well that I really enjoyed it! The carmel ice cream soon made me realize my love for caramel ice cream in genereal!

author: jasminemaewith
text: I have had sooooooo many flavors of Ben & Jerry's throughout my life. It is an amazing brand. There's always so many goodies jam packed into one container! And there's an insane amount of choices available. This one is pretty memorable due to Jimmy Fallon's face being on the container.

author: kimsparkle
text: Tonight Dough is my all time favorite Ben and Jerry's flavor. The mix of ingredients is the best. It has both chocolate and caramel ice cream along with chocolate chip cookie dough, peanut butter cookie dough, and a chocolate cookie swirl. It has a lot of texture and tastes great!

author: sallyw12
text: This is by far my favorite flavor! I've tried so many different flavors and they're all good. But I like this one the best because it has some saltiness along with the sweet chocolate, cake and cookie dough flavor. I don't care about the cost, I'll pay anything for this yummy treat.

author: MattScoops
title: Love from Canada
text: Hello! Long time scooper, first time writer. The Tonight Dough is a revelation. Many flavours that blend so well together! I especially enjoy the peanut butter dough, it surprises me every time a gob finds its way into a spoonful. Next time I'll try a different flavour... maybe...

author: taylorb9
text: My favorite Ben & Jerrys ice cream! I love a cookie dough period but this is a cut above just cookie dough. They give you caramel, chocolate chip cookie dough, peanut butter cookie dough and creamy well blended vanilla ice cream. This is crack in a cup and Im here to be drugged

author: awes0me14
title: Yes Sir Yes Sir Yes Siiiiiiiiir

author: Nephritis
title: Pretty great flavor

author: alicer9
text: Love the creaminess and all the toppings in the ice cream. This is my go-to pint to buy at grocery stores. It's loaded with the toppings, doesn't cheap out. The price for this product is decent but is amazing when it's on sale. Delicious and would recommend this to others.

author: leahro

author: Blondie95
title: Absolutely perfect!

author: tgunnlaw

author: rossrikki

author: haleymarie23
text: I absolutely love this ice cream!! It has so many different flavors all in one. I like that it has cookie dough pieces in it. Its kind of on the expensive side but its well worth it. I definitely recommend trying it if you havent and you like all the flavors it has in it.

author: erikal63

author: stephaniew80
text: 5 stars all day long. I ate this Ben and Jerry's flavor every single day while I was pregnant and still continue to love! No other ice cream company fills their flavor with as much goodies like b&j does. Every bite you have cookie dough and brownie swirl. Omg. The best.

author: brittanyv6f03
text: I love Ben and Jerry and their ice cream. I gave this one a 4 because yes, it's delicious, but it's not my favorite. If I remember correctly, it has two types of cookie dough- chocolate chip and peanut butter. This one will fill my craving when I can't find phish food.

author: jamiesc69b
text: Delicious! There is a great chocolate to vanilla ratio. I love the fudge mixed into the chocolate, but not too rich. There are lots of cookie dough bites so you can nearly get one in every other bite. No need to search. Perfectly mixed leaving very little to be desired.

author: Kirsten28
title: Really Might Be The Best Ever
text: This one really might be the best flavor ever. There are SO many chunk pieces and the cookie doughs are the best tasting cookie dough bits compared to any other brand. The caramel and chocolate ice cream is a good pair, and the texture of the cookie swirls are AMAZING.

author: kima62
text: This caramel and chocolate ice cream is truly heavenly! It is not only filled with chocolate swirls, it also contains two different types of cookie dough, peanut butter and chocolate chip! Every bite contains each of these items making for a sweet and delicious treat!

author: kaitmeadows
text: The price of Ben and Jerrys has always scared me away, but this ice cream is 16 oz of everything good in the world. It is heaven in a pint. Ben and Jerrys is revolutionary both in social causes and in phenomenal ice cream flavors. Thanks for bringing heaven to Earth.

author: legitcolleen
text: Its been too long since I had this or any Ben & Jerrys ice cream. Their ice cream is just that amazing. Except for cherry, because I do not like fruits in my ice cream, I would probably try all their flavors if I had the chance and money to. Highly highly recommend

author: kenzieebritt
text: I'm a huge Ben and Jerry's fan. I really like this flavor, it's not my favorite but still delicious! I don't reach for it every time I'm in the mood for a sweet treat, but sometimes I am just really craving it! I really love the fun, creative collaboration flavors!

author: mottagiu
text: The dairy free Ben and Jerrys ice cream is the best in my opinion. The texture is and flavor is just like regular ice cream. I think Ben and Jerrys is a bit overpriced but its totally worth it considering that they support great causes and the flavor is immaculate

author: sjm1
text: Another great flavour from Ben & Jerry's, the Tonight Dough has an amazing combination of cookie dough, chocolate, peanut butter cups and so much more. I feel guilty when I go into the tub for a 3rd and 4th scoop ... until I eat them and know that is is great.

author: kidjo22
text: If I want to indulge this is my go to! (Insert mouth water) its so good with the caramel ice cream and cookie dough bits and then you have chocolate Icecream with chunks of peanut butter cookie dough. AND the cookie swirl throughout it all, Seriously sooo good.

author: shangreen
text: Love the flavor of this ice cream. It has a great mix of tastes and fix-ins that add a good texture to the ice cream. I always purchase this product when my local Giant Eagle runs a sale on Ben and Jerrys. Otherwise, price can be a little steep for this product.

author: chrisg31
text: This is one of my girlfriend and my favorite ice creams! We purchase it anytime there is a sale on Ben and Jerry's. Loaded with cookie dough and chocolate this ice cream satisfies any craving. Ben and Jerry's has always been one of my favorite ice cream brands!

This is my favorite ice cream! Very chunky-which is a cookie dough lovers dream! The only thing to make it better would be to add more of a fudge component to the ice cream. I also wish that I could find this flavor in the mini-size, rather than just the pint

author: adriannae4
text: My favorite Ben and Jerrys go to ice cream if Im watching a movie or just need to have a moment. The chunky chocolatey ice cream is what I seek in all of the ice creams I buy and this one is perfect. I like the pb cookies too its a different flavor in the mix.

author: keriannhb95d
text: My friends and I often like to take part in taste tests, and this one won out of the 6 brands we tried! Not only is the ice cream itself very creamy and delicious, they have a good amount of chunks and goodies in them. It is expensive but well worth the cost.

author: tessm17
text: The tonight dough is my go to for Ben and Jerry. I mean who doesn't love brownie, cookie dough and Jimmy Fallon. Im always down to try a new flavour but usually find myself reaching for this or the half-baked flavour. Can't go wrong with what you know, right?

author: theresah29
text: Ben and jerrys ice cream is so good! They have so many wonderful flavors its hard to choose just one. My absolute favorite is the tonight dough. This ice cream never disappoints my taste buds. The only thing is i always finish the whole tub! Its just so good.

author: Nicg63
title: Use to love it

author: Awhite
title: Eh
text: Too much of a chocolate flavor and not enough cookie dough chunks. Not sure if it's freezer burned or an old batch but often the cookie dough chunks will break apart like powder with a terrible taste. Not a bad flavor if cookie dough is like it should be.

author: millervolt
text: This. Is. The best. Ice cream I've ever had. It has everything you could want in ice cream. It has vanilla, rich chocolate, caramel, peanut butter, cookie crumbles, and cookie dough. Just simply amazing. I will be buying more of this as soon as I get home.

author: pineapplesp
text: Love this flavor. Its filled with different types of cookie dough and its tastes heavenly. Each spoonful of ice cream will contain a type of cookie dough and ice cream. I would 100% recommend if cookie dough is your favorite part of cookie dough ice cream.

author: my2babies11

author: iluvujennay
text: When I am craving cookie dough ice cream, this is always the brand I go for. The chunks of Cookie dough are large and worth the money. Its like having an ice cream store in your freezer. I would highly suggest trying this brand if you have an already yet.

author: Eve_
title: Weird PB dough

author: madiem7
text: This is hands down my all time favorite ice cream flavor. The dough bites in the ice cream are larger than all other brands and have the perfect level of sweetness. If you are a cookie dough fanatic buy this it will satisfy all your cookie dough cravings

author: Yaskween

author: aniburk

author: Trina

author: jennyi2

author: samanthab37bf

author: msnyder2
text: One of my favorite B&J flavors. Not only do I love Jimmy Fallon, but this flavor has a great mix of caramel, chocolate ice cream and chocolate chip and peanut butter cookie doughs. DELICIOUS. Its like taking cookie dough ice cream to the next level.

author: anne02

THIS IS THE BEST!!!!! I love this ice cream with everything in me!! it combines all the best sweets into one and is so creamy but has a fun texture with the brownie and cookie dough. My whole family loves this flavor so it goes quickly in our house.

author: edenmetz
text: This is my favorite ice cream of all time! Ben & Jerry's is so creative and has so many great flavors throughout their entire line. Tonight Dough or not, you will not go wrong with choosing any single one of their flavors! I highly recommend this!

author: mikafalciola
text: Their ice cream is good, but have you seen their stance to abolish white supremacy? That is what makes their flavors pop! I will now buy more Ben & Jerrys. This flavor is really good though, all of the sweets you like in one combined flavor! BLM!

author: emilyc403

author: hollandm
text: Hands down the best ice cream. If you love sweets this has it all. A step up from your typical cookie dough ice cream, this one has peanut butter and chocolate chip cookie dough chunks along with even more. Every bite will be filled with cookie.

author: denisec16

author: lipkit99

author: amazinggracematthew

author: justicem8

author: clairep2

author: katpereira21

author: sarahc354

author: Lindsey D
title: Best thing EVER
text:
So, I want to start off by saying my addiction to this started on my birthday 2 years ago, I was like " OH! I'll try this it sounds good." And the rest was history. This ice cream has got to be my all time favorite over all other ice creams ever, from marble creamers to mom and pop stores, large brands to small brands. ALL TIME FAVORITE! I've always been the kind of girl that's more like 'Ice Cream in my toppings,' not toppings in my ice cream. This totally hits the spot! It's like Vanilla/Chocolate ice cream with "chocolate cookie" ribbon like swirls, and chunks of both chocolate chip cookie dough and PB cookie dough. IT IS AMAZING, so amazing that when my local grocer puts it on sale by even 0.25 its sold out before any other flavor.
As to some of the reviews saying the favor changed, I think its more the retailer your buying it from. I don't get mine from Target any more b/c they let the ice cream melt a bit before they can get it stored again. I'm pretty sure that ruins it a bit b/c it mushes the flavors all up and makes things wonkie. That's probably what happened to some of you all. When i got a few like that over a couple of months the PB tasted off, not bad, just off. Kinda like switch from JIF to Skippie or whatever they are called. Either way, I'd say try this flavor if you like Ice cream with your toppings, and are a fan of cookie dough in general.

author: tonightdoughlover5
title: DELICIOUS LITERALLY THE BEST THING IN THIS WORLD
text: this ice cream singlehandedly provides me with 3 days worth of seratonin. every bite is pure joy, ecstasy, and transcends all human taste possibility. let’s get real here ladies THREE TYPES OF COOKIE DOUGH!!! and it’s not like most cookie dough ice cream where you’re eating for a while and go, “where’s the cookie dough??” NO!!! THERE IS COOKIE DOUGH IN EVERY BITE BRUH!!! the distribution of the cookie dough within the ice cream is my favorite part however, the ice cream itself is beautiful. because it’s not all chocolate it makes me feel a little better about stuffing it into my esophagus. The Tonight Dough is NOT just an ice cream it is a way of LIFE!!! in fact i have spent TWO YEARS searching for an ice cream that gives me the same RUSH as a spoonful of this heaven, alas none quite do the trick. If i had a chance to time travel i would travel back and give whomever came up with this concept for ice cream a BIG OLE SMOOCH!!! they truly outdid themselves. i no longer buy any any ANY other ice cream at stores because this is the ONLY ice cream worth eating. A song once said “I scream, you scream, we ALL scream for ice cream”. i will personally guarantee you NO SCREAM can match the pure HAPPINESS that RUSHES through my veins when i open the freezer and see jimmy fallon there. NOT because i love jimmy fallon but because of the pure adrenaline coursing through me at the thought of the cookie dough confection that is the TONIGHT DOUGHHH!!!! i now have a pavlovian response you mr fallon’s face. It causes me to salivate profusely. In all seriousness THIS IS THE BEST THING YOU WILL EVER EAT. I LOVE YOU BEN I LOVE YOU JERRY THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR THE PURE HAPPINESS!!!!! <3
